330	    print(f"  sliding_window={attn.sliding_window}")
331	    print(f"  num_params={cfg.num_params:,}"
332	          f"  non_embedding={cfg.num_non_embedding_params:,}")
333	
334	# ── 第 2 步：kwargs 定制 olmo2_14M ──
335	custom = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(
336	    vocab_size=VOCAB,
337	    n_layers=6,  # 4 -> 6
338	    n_heads=4,   # 8 -> 4（head_dim 在构建期推导为 128 // 4 = 32）
339	)
340	attn = custom.block.sequence_mixer
341	print("[custom olmo2_14M]")
342	print(f"  d_model={custom.d_model}  n_layers={custom.n_layers}"
343	      f"  n_heads={attn.n_heads}  ffn_hidden={custom.block.feed_forward.hidden_size}")
344	print(f"  预算 num_params={custom.num_params:,}")
345	
346	model = custom.build()  # CPU 上直接构建
347	actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
348	print(f"  实际 num_params={actual:,}  一致: {custom.num_params == actual}")
349	```
350	
351	**需要观察的现象**与**预期结果**（依据源码可推导的部分）：
352	
353	- `d_model` 两者都是 2048；**`n_layers` 不同：olmo2_1B 为 18，olmo3_1B 为 16**（前者走 `llama2_1B` 默认，后者走 `olmo2_1B_v2` 默认）。
354	- 两者 `n_heads=16`、`n_kv_heads=None`（留空表示 MHA，构建期才展开为 16）；FFN 宽度按 4.3.2 的公式都推得 8192。
355	- **注意力配置是最大差异**：`olmo2_1B` 的 `backend` 为 `None`（构建时自动选择）、`sliding_window=None`（全程全注意力）；`olmo3_1B` 显式 `backend=flash_2`，且 `sliding_window.pattern=[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]`——16 层下全注意力层为 3、7、11、15（推导见 4.3.3 ②）。
356	- 第 2 步：定制后 `n_layers=6`、`n_heads=4`；`olmo2_14M` 未指定 multiplier，FFN 宽度按 \(h = 256 \cdot \lceil \lfloor 8 \cdot 128 / 3 \rfloor / 256 \rceil = 256 \cdot \lceil 341/256 \rceil = 512\) 推得 512。
357	- 最后一行应打印 `一致: True`（有 [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L88-L93](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L88-L93) 的同类断言背书）。
358	- 两个配置的具体参数量数值与脚本输出**待本地验证**。
359	
360	顺带一提：`config_test.py` 中的 `test_load_olmo3_7b_config`（[src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py:L14-L30](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py#L14-L30)）会从真实 OLMo 3 7B checkpoint 下载 `config.json` 并还原成 `TransformerConfig`（`d_model=4096, n_layers=32`）——预置工厂与序列化体系共同保证了「官方模型 ↔ Config」的双向可追溯。
361	
362	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
363	
364	**练习 1**：`olmo2_1B` 与 `olmo2_1B_v2` 有什么区别？`olmo3_1B` 基于哪一个？
365	**答案**：两者都委托 `llama2_1B`，但 `olmo2_1B` 用其默认 `n_layers=18`，`olmo2_1B_v2` 显式默认 `n_layers=16` 且对齐旧 OLMo trainer 的 1B（docstring 见 [L724-L731](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L724-L731)）。`olmo3_1B` 基于 `olmo2_1B_v2`（[L983](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L983)），所以也是 16 层。
366	
367	**练习 2**：不实例化模型，如何知道 `olmo2_32B` 用了 GQA？FFN 宽度是多少？
368	**答案**：读工厂方法（[L788-L807](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L788-L807)）：`n_heads=40, n_kv_heads=8`，8 < 40 即 GQA。FFN 宽度代入公式：\(h_0=\lfloor 8 \cdot 5120/3 \rfloor=13653\)，乘 \(27648/13653.33\approx 2.025\) 后取整得 27647，对齐到 512 的倍数得 **27648**——multiplier 正是反着凑出来的。
369	
370	**练习 3**：想给一个 olmo3 预设换掉注意力后端，该怎么做？
371	**答案**：工厂的 `attn_backend` 旋钮本身就是 kwargs 可覆盖的，例如 `TransformerConfig.olmo3_190M(vocab_size=..., attn_backend=AttentionBackendName.flash_3)`——每个 olmo3 工厂都用 `kwargs.pop("attn_backend", AttentionBackendName.flash_2)` 接收它（如 [L912](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L912)）。
372	
373	## 5. 综合实践
374	
375	把本讲三块知识串成一次「预设巡检 + 定制 + 序列化」的小任务。在 `OLMo-core-tutorial/` 下新建 `presets_tour.py`（示例代码）：
376	
377	```python
378	# presets_tour.py（示例代码）
379	import json
380	
381	from olmo_core.nn.attention import SlidingWindowAttentionConfig
382	from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig
383	
384	VOCAB = 50_304
385	
386	# 1) 巡检：把 olmo2 全阶梯的关键超参整理成表
387	sizes = ["olmo2_1M", "olmo2_14M", "olmo2_100M", "olmo2_190M", "olmo2_1B_v2"]
388	print(f"{'preset':<14}{'d_model':>8}{'layers':>7}{'heads':>6}{'ffn':>7}{'params':>14}")
389	for name in sizes:
390	    cfg = getattr(TransformerConfig, name)(vocab_size=VOCAB)
391	    print(f"{name:<14}{cfg.d_model:>8}{cfg.n_layers:>7}"
392	          f"{cfg.block.sequence_mixer.n_heads:>6}"
393	          f"{cfg.block.feed_forward.hidden_size:>7}{cfg.num_params:>14,}")
394	
395	# 2) 定制：在 olmo2_190M 基础上加深 + 换滑窗模式
396	cfg = TransformerConfig.olmo2_190M(
397	    vocab_size=VOCAB,
398	    n_layers=16,
399	    sliding_window=SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(
400	        pattern=[2048, -1],                       # 1:1 交替：滑窗 / 全注意力
401	        force_full_attention_on_first_layer=True,
402	        force_full_attention_on_last_layer=True,
403	    ),
404	)
405	
406	# 3) 序列化往返：定制结果应能无损存取（呼应 u2-l1 的 round-trip）
407	d = cfg.as_config_dict()
408	print(json.dumps(d, indent=2)[:400], "...")  # 检查 _CLASS_/type 线索与滑窗字段
409	cfg2 = TransformerConfig.from_dict(json.loads(json.dumps(d)))
410	print("round-trip 一致:", cfg2.as_config_dict() == d)
411	
412	# 4) 参数量对账
413	model = cfg.build()
414	print("num_params 一致:", cfg.num_params == sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()))
415	```
416	
417	任务要求：
418	
419	1. 运行脚本，记录步骤 1 的表格——观察 d_model / n_layers / FFN 宽度如何随档位增长（各档 FFN 宽度可按 4.3.2 公式手工推导核对）。
420	2. 解释步骤 2 中 `pattern=[2048, -1]` 在 16 层下哪些层是全注意力（提示：首末层被强制全注意力，模式从第 1 层起循环——具体层数组合待本地验证，可与 `_get_window_size` 的推导对照）。
421	3. 确认步骤 3、4 都打印 `True`。若第 3 步为 `False`，说明序列化丢了信息，回头检查是不是传了不可 JSON 化的对象。
422	
423	预期：四步全部成功即完成本任务；具体数值输出待本地验证。
424	
425	## 6. 本讲小结
426	
427	- `TransformerConfig` 是模型全部形状的图纸：5 个必填字段（`d_model`/`vocab_size`/`n_layers`/`block`/`lm_head`）定骨架，其余字段管 block 组织、初始化、词表与输出；构造时 `__post_init__` 即校验非法组合。
428	- `block` 有三种组织方式：单 block、命名 block + `block_pattern` 循环（混合架构用）、单 block + `block_overrides` 逐层覆盖；`resolved_block_configs` 把它们统一成「每层一个配置」的列表。
429	- `build()` 按 `name` 分发到 `Transformer`/`NormalizedTransformer`/`MoETransformer`，支持 `init_device="meta"` 占位与 `freeze_params` 通配冻结；`num_params` 是不实例化就精确成立的参数量预算（有测试断言背书）。
430	- 预置工厂是一座三层金字塔：规模档位（olmo2_1M…olmo2_32B、olmo3 系列）→ 架构预设（llama2/gemma3/qwen3…）→ 家族装配（`llama_like` 等）；**kwargs.pop + 向下透传**让一行调用既能选档位又能改任何深层参数。
431	- olmo3 预设 = 对应 olmo2 预设 + 滑窗模式 `[4096,4096,4096,-1]` + flash_2 后端；`olmo3_1B` 特例：基于 `olmo2_1B_v2`（16 层而非 18 层）。
432	- `with_rope_scaling` 展示了 Config 级组合子风格：返回改造后的副本，用 `block_overrides` 只放大全注意力层的 RoPE。
433	
434	## 7. 下一步学习建议
435	
436	- **下一讲 u3-l3（注意力机制与可插拔后端）**：本讲多次遇到 `attn_backend`、`sliding_window`、`qk_norm`，下一讲深入 `AttentionConfig` 背后的 `Attention` 基类与各后端实现。
437	- **u3-l4（核心组件）**：`FeedForwardConfig.hidden_size` 的宽度如何变成 SwiGLU 三矩阵、`LMHeadConfig` 与 `LayerNormConfig` 的字段含义。
438	- **u3-l6（模型初始化）**：本讲只点了 `init_method`/`init_std` 枚举，初始化方案如何按参数类型生效留到那讲展开。
439	- **延伸阅读源码**：通读 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py) 中你还没读过的工厂（`gemma3_like`、`llama_like_moe`），对照本文的三层金字塔模型检验你的理解。

# TransformerConfig 与预置架构工厂方法

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u3-l1）我们读了 `Transformer` 与 `TransformerBlock` 的前向主链路，知道了数据如何从 `input_ids` 一路流到 logits。本讲把视角拉回到「模型是怎么被描述出来的」：

1. 读懂 `TransformerConfig` 中每个字段对应的模型结构含义——看完你就知道一张「模型图纸」上到底画了哪些信息。
2. 会用 `olmo2_190M()`、`olmo3_7B()` 这类预置工厂方法快速构建模型配置，并说清楚 olmo2 与 olmo3 预设的差别。
3. 掌握贯穿全库的复用模式：**Config 工厂方法 + kwargs 覆盖**——一行调用既能选定规模档位，又能随手改掉任何深层参数。
4. 理解 `build()` 如何从图纸初始化出一个真实模型，以及 `num_params` 如何在建模之前就精确算出参数量。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲假设你已读过：

- **u2-l1 / u2-l2**：`Config` 是可序列化的嵌套 dataclass，`ModuleConfig` 提供抽象的 `build()`，`ModelConfig` 再加上 `num_params` 等属性。`TransformerConfig` 正是这条继承链的成员。
- **u3-l1**：`Transformer` 顶层只做编排，`n_layers` 个 `TransformerBlock` 堆叠在残差流上；OLMo 2 默认 block 是 `reordered_norm`（norm 在子层输出侧）。

几个本讲反复出现的术语，先用一句话解释：

| 术语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `d_model` | 残差流宽度（隐藏维度）。中间所有层都保持这个宽度，形状只在 embedding 入口和 lm_head 出口变化。 |
| `n_heads` / `n_kv_heads` | 查询头数 / 键值头数。`n_kv_heads < n_heads` 时就是 **GQA**（分组查询注意力，多组 Q 共享一组 KV，省 KV cache 与投影参数）；`n_kv_heads` 留空（`None`）表示等于 `n_heads`，即标准 MHA。 |
| `head_dim` | 每个注意力头的维度。留空时在构建期推导为 `d_model // n_heads`（见 [src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py:L700-L704](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L700-L704)）。部分模型（如 Qwen3）会显式指定与 `d_model // n_heads` 不同的 `head_dim`。 |
| FFN hidden size | 前馈网络（SwiGLU）中间层宽度。`llama_like` 里由 `d_model` 乘系数推导（见 4.3.3）。 |
| `reordered_norm` | OLMo 2 的 block 布局：两个 LayerNorm 放在注意力/FFN 的输出侧（post-norm 风格）。 |
| RoPE `theta` | 旋转位置编码的基频，越大越适合长上下文（OLMo 2/3 用 500 000，Qwen3 用 1 000 000）。 |
| 参数量预算 | `num_params`：不实例化模型，仅凭 Config 算出的精确参数总数。 |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py) | **本讲主角**。`TransformerConfig`、`TransformerBlockConfig`、全部预置工厂方法、block 解析逻辑都在这一个文件里（约 2200 行）。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py) | `ModuleConfig` / `ModelConfig` 抽象基类，定义 `build()` 与 `num_params` 契约。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/init.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/init.py) | `InitMethod` 枚举：权重初始化方案（详细机制在 u3-l6 展开）。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py) | `AttentionConfig`、`SlidingWindowAttentionConfig` 等被 `TransformerConfig` 组合的子配置。 |
| [src/olmo_core/utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/utils.py) | `ensure_multiple_of`：FFN 宽度对齐工具。 |
| [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py) | 断言 `config.num_params` 与实际构建参数量严格相等；展示 kwargs 覆盖用法。 |
| [src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py) | 配置加载、round-trip 与工厂方法的回归测试。 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 TransformerConfig：一张描述模型全部形状的图纸

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

u3-l1 里我们直接读了 `Transformer` 类的 `__init__` 参数——那有十几个位置参数，手工拼装既繁琐又容易错。`TransformerConfig` 解决的就是这个问题：把「造一个 Transformer 需要知道的一切」收进一个可序列化、可校验、可复用的 dataclass。

它的设计要点：

1. **复合配置**：`TransformerConfig` 不重复定义注意力、FFN、LayerNorm 的细节，而是嵌套持有 `TransformerBlockConfig`、`LMHeadConfig` 等子配置——这正是 u2-l1 讲过的「Config 嵌套组合」模式。
2. **顶层管形状，block 管内部**：`d_model`、`n_layers` 这类全局量在顶层；每个 block 内部用什么注意力、什么 FFN 由 `TransformerBlockConfig` 描述。
3. **构造即校验**：`__post_init__` 在对象诞生时就拒绝非法组合（比如 `tie_word_embeddings` 搭配 normalized transformer）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`TransformerConfig` 的字段可以分成四组来记：

```text
┌─ 形状骨架 ─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  d_model / vocab_size / n_layers                        │
├─ block 的组织方式 ──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  block（单个 或 dict[str, 多个命名 block]）              │
│  block_pattern（命名 block 的循环模式）                   │
│  block_overrides（按层号覆盖单 block）                    │
├─ 初始化 ────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  init_method / init_seed / init_std / embedding_init_std │
│  dtype / freeze_params                                  │
├─ 词表与输出 ────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lm_head / embedding_norm / embed_scale                 │
│  tie_word_embeddings / n_extra_vocab                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

构造流程：`TransformerConfig(...)` → dataclass 赋值 → `__post_init__` 校验 → 得到一个可 `build()`、可 `as_config_dict()` 序列化的纯数据对象。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① 继承链与字段定义。** `TransformerConfig` 继承 `ModelConfig`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L335-L362](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L335-L362)）：前五个字段 `d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 没有默认值，是必填项；其余都有默认值。注意 `block` 字段的类型是联合类型 `TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig]`——这正是 4.2 节「block 三种组织方式」的入口。`name: TransformerType = TransformerType.default` 决定顶层用哪个实现类（default → `Transformer`，normalized → nGPT，moe → `MoETransformer`，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L80-L103](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L80-L103)）。

**② `__post_init__` 校验。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L372-L397](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L372-L397) 依次检查：normalized transformer 不许 tie 词嵌入；`n_extra_vocab` 非负且只支持 default 类型；然后调用 `validate_block_resolution_config` 确保 `block` / `block_pattern` / `block_overrides` 三者组合合法（细节见 4.2.3）。若 `n_layers` 不能被 `block_pattern` 长度整除，只发 warning 不报错——模式会循环后截断。

**③ `TransformerBlockConfig` 的字段。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L162-L212](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L162-L212)：

- `sequence_mixer`：序列混合器配置（通常是 `AttentionConfig`，也可以是 `GatedDeltaNetConfig` 等线性注意力——Qwen3.5 预设就是这么用的）。它是唯一必填字段。
- `attention`：已废弃的 `InitVar`，仅为兼容旧配置保留；`__post_init__` 里会把它搬到 `sequence_mixer`（[L214-L226](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L214-L226)）。
- `layer_norm` / `feed_forward` / `feed_forward_moe`：dense block 需要 `feed_forward`，MoE block 需要 `feed_forward_moe`，hybrid MoE 则两者都有。
- `name: TransformerBlockType`：选 block 布局（default / reordered_norm / peri_norm / moe 系列等，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L106-L159](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L106-L159)）。
- `dropout` / `masked_dropout` / `attention_residual_alpha` / `feed_forward_residual_alpha`：正则与残差缩放的可选项。

**④ 基类契约。** `ModuleConfig` 只要求一个抽象 `build()`（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L9-L16](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L9-L16)）；`ModelConfig` 再要求 `num_params`、`num_non_embedding_params` 两个抽象属性（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L19-L43](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L19-L43)）。`TransformerConfig` 把这些全部实现了。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不看工厂方法，手写一个最小的合法 `TransformerConfig`，并亲身体验一次校验报错。

**操作步骤**（以下为示例代码，可在仓库根目录用 `python -I` 逐段运行）：

from olmo_core.nn.feed_forward import FeedForwardConfig
from olmo_core.nn.layer_norm import LayerNormConfig
from olmo_core.nn.lm_head import LMHeadConfig

    TransformerBlockConfig, TransformerBlockType, TransformerConfig,

d_model = 64
block = TransformerBlockConfig(
    name=TransformerBlockType.reordered_norm,
    sequence_mixer=AttentionConfig(
        n_heads=4, bias=False, rope=RoPEConfig(theta=500_000),
    ),
    feed_forward=FeedForwardConfig(hidden_size=176, bias=False),
    layer_norm=LayerNormConfig(bias=False),

cfg = TransformerConfig(
    d_model=d_model, vocab_size=128, n_layers=2, block=block,

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`TransformerConfig` 有约 18 个字段，为什么只有 5 个必填？
**答案**：`d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 定义了模型的最小形状骨架，库无法替你猜；其余字段（dtype、init 系列、tie_word_embeddings 等）都有合理默认值，属于「可选微调」。

**练习 2**：`TransformerBlockConfig.sequence_mixer` 为什么不叫 `attention`？
**答案**：因为序列混合器是一个可替换插槽——大多数预设放 `AttentionConfig`，但 Qwen3.5 等混合架构会放 `GatedDeltaNetConfig`（线性注意力）。旧名 `attention` 保留为废弃的 `InitVar` 仅为加载旧配置（见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L172-L177](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L172-L177)）。

**练习 3**：`n_extra_vocab` 字段是给谁用的？
**答案**：给 Molmo2 多模态模型——把 128 个图像专用 token 作为**独立参数**追加到 embedding 表后面；这些 token 只作为输入、永远不是预测目标（字段文档见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L362-L370](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L362-L370)）。

### 4.2 从图纸到模型：block 解析、`build()` 与参数量预算

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

图纸画好后有两个问题：`block` 字段允许「单 block」「命名 block + 模式」「单 block + 逐层覆盖」三种写法，`build()` 前要先统一成「每层一个 `TransformerBlockConfig`」的列表；此外，我们希望**不实例化模型就能知道参数量**——这对实验规划（显存预算、优化器状态估算）非常重要。

这两个需求分别由 `resolve_block_configs()` 与 `num_params` 属性满足。`num_params` 是纯算术：各子配置都实现了自己的 `num_params(d_model)`，顶层把它们加总。测试保证了它与真实参数量分毫不差。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

**block 解析**（伪代码）：

```text
resolve_block_configs(n_layers, block, block_pattern, block_overrides):
    若 block 是 dict（命名 block）:
        pattern 按 cycle 循环，截取前 n_layers 项
        返回 [block[name] for name in 截取后的 pattern]
    否则（单 block）:
        结果 = [block] * n_layers
        对 block_overrides 中的每个 (层号, 覆盖配置): 结果[层号] = 覆盖配置
        返回 结果
```

**`build()` 流程**：

1. 先打印参数量预算日志；
2. 按 `self.name` 分发到 `Transformer` / `NormalizedTransformer` / `MoETransformer` 构造函数（`moe_fused_v2` 直接抛 `RuntimeError`，要求改用 `OLMoDDPModelConfig`）；
3. 若设置了 `freeze_params`，用 `fnmatch` 逐个参数名匹配并置 `requires_grad=False`；
4. 打印模型摘要，返回模型。

**参数量公式**（对应 `num_params` 属性的求和顺序）：

\[
N_{\text{total}} = \underbrace{d \cdot V}_{\text{embedding}} + \underbrace{N_{\text{norm}}^{emb}}_{\text{embedding norm}} + \sum_{i=1}^{L} N_{\text{block}}^{(i)}(d) + \underbrace{N_{\text{lm\_head}}(d, V)}_{\text{输出头}} - \mathbb{1}_{\text{tied}} \cdot d \cdot V
\]

其中 \(d\) 为 `d_model`，\(V\) 为 `vocab_size`，\(L\) 为 `n_layers`；最后一项表示 tie 词嵌入时 lm_head 与 embedding 共享权重，要减去一份。而**非嵌入参数量**就是：

\[
N_{\text{non-emb}} = N_{\text{total}} - d \cdot V
\]

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① block 解析。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L2176-L2206](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2176-L2206) 是 `resolve_block_configs`：dict 分支用 `islice(cycle(block_pattern), n_layers)` 把模式循环截断到 `n_layers` 长；单 block 分支先铺满再应用 `block_overrides`。配套的 `validate_block_resolution_config`（[L2144-L2173](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2144-L2173)）负责拒绝非法组合：dict 必须配 pattern、dict 不许再用 overrides、pattern 里的名字必须都在 dict 中。顶层属性 `resolved_block_configs`（[L497-L504](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L497-L504)）就是对这个函数的封装。

**② `build()`。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L399-L495](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L399-L495)。注意两个细节：其一，`init_device` 参数（[L399-L409](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L399-L409)）默认 `"cpu"`，分布式训练时通常传 `"meta"`——这就是 u1-l4 说过的「模型先在 meta 设备占位，再由并行策略落位」；其二，`freeze_params` 的 fnmatch 匹配循环（[L477-L485](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L477-L485)）支持 `*"wq"` 这类通配符按参数名冻结。

**③ 参数量预算。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L506-L529](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L506-L529) 严格按上面公式求和；`num_non_embedding_params`（[L556-L561](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L556-L561)）就是简单相减。block 一侧的 `TransformerBlockConfig.num_params(d_model)`（[L295-L322](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L295-L322)）把序列混合器、两个 norm、FFN/MoE 逐项相加——标准 block 恰好计两次 `layer_norm`（注意力一次、FFN 一次），与 reordered_norm 布局里每 block 两个 norm 对应。MoE 场景还有 `num_active_params`（每 token 实际激活的参数量，[L531-L554](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L531-L554)），这是评估 MoE 推理/训练成本时更贴心的指标。

**④ 测试证据。** `test_small_llama2_builder_config`（[src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L82-L105](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L82-L105)）构建 `llama2_271M` 后逐参数 `numel()` 求和，并断言 `config.num_params == num_actual_params == model.num_params` 三者相等——预算不是估算，是精确值。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：验证「参数量预算 = 真实参数量」，并体会 `block_overrides` 的用法。

**操作步骤**（示例代码）：

```python
from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig

cfg = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(vocab_size=1_000)
print(f"预算: total={cfg.num_params:,}  non-emb={cfg.num_non_embedding_params:,}")

model = cfg.build()  # CPU 构建
actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"实际: {actual:,}  相等: {cfg.num_params == actual}")

# block_overrides：把第 0 层换成带 dropout 的副本
block0 = cfg.block.copy()
block0.dropout = 0.1
cfg2 = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(vocab_size=1_000, block_overrides={0: block0})
print(f"覆盖后层数不变: {len(cfg2.resolved_block_configs)}")
print(f"第 0 层 dropout={cfg2.resolved_block_configs[0].dropout}, "
      f"第 1 层 dropout={cfg2.resolved_block_configs[1].dropout}")
```

**需要观察的现象**：预算与实际参数量相等；`resolved_block_configs` 长度等于 `n_layers`，且只有第 0 层的 dropout 被改成 0.1，其余层仍是 `None`。

**预期结果**：两行 `相等: True`、`dropout=0.1` 与 `dropout=None`。参数量数值待本地验证。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `tie_word_embeddings=True` 时 `num_params` 要减去 `d_model * vocab_size`？
**答案**：tie 意味着 lm_head 与 embedding 共享同一份权重张量，`named_parameters()` 里只会出现一次；求和时却分别计入了 embedding 和 lm_head 两份，必须扣除一份（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L526-L527](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L526-L527)）。

**练习 2**：`resolved_block_configs` 是普通字段还是 property？为什么？
**答案**：是 property（[L497-L504](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L497-L504)）。因为它依赖 `n_layers`/`block`/`block_pattern`/`block_overrides` 四个字段的组合结果，若存成字段，任何一个字段被修改后都可能过期；property 每次现算，永远一致。

**练习 3**：`build()` 里 `name=TransformerType.moe_fused_v2` 会发生什么？
**答案**：抛出 `RuntimeError("Use OLMoDDPModelConfig")`（[L472-L473](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L472-L473)）。融合 MoE-v2 模型要用 `TransformerConfig` 的子类 `OLMoDDPModelConfig`（[L2052-L2141](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2052-L2141)），它自带重计算、双 batch 重叠等额外开关——这也是「通过子类扩展 Config」的范例。

### 4.3 预置架构工厂方法：olmo2 阶梯与 llama_like 复用模式

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

手写 `TransformerConfig` 太繁琐，而且 OLMo 2、OLMo 3、Llama、Qwen 等架构的正确超参组合本身就值得沉淀。`TransformerConfig` 上挂了三类 `classmethod` 工厂：

1. **规模档位工厂**：`olmo2_14M()`、`olmo2_190M()`、`olmo2_1B()`……名字是规模档位（配 OLMo 词表时的名义参数量级），从 1M 一路到 32B。
2. **家族装配工厂**：`llama_like()`、`ngpt_like()`、`gemma3_like()`、`qwen3_5_like()`——把一组超参翻译成完整的嵌套 Config 树。
3. **Config 级组合子**：`with_rope_scaling()` 这类「拿一个现成配置、返回改造后副本」的方法。

这些工厂共享同一个复用哲学——**工厂方法 + kwargs 覆盖**：每个工厂只 `pop` 自己关心的少数旋钮并给出默认值，把剩余 `**kwargs` 原样向下游传递，最终汇入 `cls(...)`。于是 `olmo2_190M(vocab_size=..., n_layers=2, sliding_window=...)` 一次调用中：`n_layers` 在 190M 这层被吃掉、`sliding_window` 被透传给 `llama_like`——测试代码 [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L181-L205](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L181-L205) 的 `get_transformer_config` 就是这种一行式调用的活例子。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

工厂调用是一座三层金字塔：

```text
TransformerConfig.olmo3_1B(vocab_size, **kwargs)     ← 规模档位（olmo3 = olmo2 + 滑窗 + flash_2）
        │  委托
        ▼
TransformerConfig.olmo2_1B_v2(vocab_size, **kwargs)  ← 规模档位（指定 n_layers=16）
        │  委托
        ▼
TransformerConfig.llama2_1B(vocab_size, **kwargs)    ← 架构预设（d_model=2048 等）
        │  委托
        ▼
TransformerConfig.llama_like(**所有参数)              ← 家族装配：拼出 block / lm_head / 子配置
        │  cls(...)
        ▼
TransformerConfig 实例
```

`llama_like` 内部决定 FFN 宽度的规则是（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1723-L1727](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1723-L1727)）：

\[
h_0 = \left\lfloor \frac{8d}{3} \right\rfloor,\qquad
h_1 = \lfloor m \cdot h_0 \rfloor,\qquad
h = k \cdot \left\lceil \frac{h_1}{k} \right\rceil
\]

其中 \(d\) 是 `d_model`，\(m\) 是可选的 `hidden_size_multiplier`，\(k\) 是 `hidden_size_multiple_of`（默认 256，`ensure_multiple_of` 见 [src/olmo_core/utils.py:L903-L904](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/utils.py#L903-L904)）。例：`d=2048, m=1.5` 时 \(h_0=5461\)，\(h_1=8191\)，对齐到 256 的倍数得 \(h=8192\)。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① olmo2 规模阶梯。** 每个档位都是对 `llama_like` 的一次参数化调用。以 `olmo2_190M` 为例（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L647-L660](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L647-L660)）：`d_model=768`、`hidden_size_multiplier=1.5`、`n_layers=12`、`n_heads=12`，并统一 `block_name=reordered_norm`、`qk_norm=True`、`rope_theta=500_000`、`layer_norm_eps=1e-6`。`olmo2_14M`（[L586-L598](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L586-L598)）则是 `d_model=128, n_layers=4, n_heads=8`。较大档位改为委托给 llama2 预设：`olmo2_1B` → `llama2_1B`（[L707-L722](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L707-L722)，默认 `n_layers=18`）；`olmo2_7B` → `llama2_7B`（[L760-L772](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L760-L772)）。`olmo2_32B`（[L788-L807](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L788-L807)）值得细看：`d_model=5120, n_layers=64, n_heads=40, n_kv_heads=8`（GQA），且 `hidden_size_multiplier=27648/(8·5120/3)`、`hidden_size_multiple_of=512`——代入公式恰好凑出 FFN 宽度 27648。

**② olmo3 = olmo2 + 滑窗注意力 + flash_2。** 全部 `olmo3_*` 工厂结构一致，以 `olmo3_1B` 为例（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L978-L996](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L978-L996)）：调用对应的 olmo2 工厂（注意是 `olmo2_1B_v2`，默认 `n_layers=16`，而非 `olmo2_1B` 的 18 层！），再追加两样东西——`sliding_window=SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(force_full_attention_on_first_layer=False, force_full_attention_on_last_layer=True, pattern=[4096, 4096, 4096, -1])` 和 `attn_backend=flash_2`。滑窗语义见字段文档（[src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py:L252-L269](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L252-L269)）：`-1` 表示全注意力，即每 4 层里前 3 层只看 4096 窗口、第 4 层全局；`_get_window_size`（[L271-L291](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L271-L291)）还处理首末层的强制规则。对 16 层的 olmo3_1B 推导一遍：首层不强制全注意力、末层（第 15 层）强制，模式从第 0 层开始循环——全注意力层为 3、7、11、15。另注意 `olmo3_600M` 是唯一还改了 `d_model`（1280）的例外（[L944](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L944)）。

**③ `llama_like` 装配主体。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1676-L1800](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1676-L1800)：先算 FFN 宽度（L1723-1727），再配全局 LayerNorm（默认 `rms`，`fused_ops=True` 时 `fused_rms`，L1729-1737），然后决定注意力实现（`fused_ops` 且无 GQA 时自动切 `fused_v2` + flash_2 后端，L1739-1747），拼出单个 `TransformerBlockConfig`（L1753-1779），最后 `cls(...)` 落成 `TransformerConfig`（L1791-1800）。中间的 `block_mods` 钩子（L1781-1789）允许按层号传入「改 block 配置的函数」，比 `block_overrides` 更 programmable，两者互斥。

**④ 混合架构与命名 block。** `qwen3_5_like`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1584-L1674](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1584-L1674)）构造两种 block——`gdn`（GatedDeltaNet 线性注意力）与 `attn`（全注意力），以 `block={"gdn": ..., "attn": ...}` + `block_pattern=["gdn","gdn","gdn","attn"]` 的 3:1 模式组装；`gemma3_like`（[L1910-L2003](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1910-L2003)）同样用 `local`/`global` 两种 block 按 5:1 循环，并设置 `embed_scale=sqrt(d_model)`。这就是 `block` 字段允许 dict 的意义。

**⑤ Config 级组合子。** `with_rope_scaling`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L2005-L2049](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2005-L2049)）返回配置副本，把 RoPE 缩放只加在全注意力层（滑窗层跳过），实现方式正是批量生成 `block_overrides`——长上下文训练脚本靠它在中期扩展上下文。

**⑥ MoE 预设。** `smallmoe`（[L1078-L1100](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1078-L1100)）、`olmoe_1B_7B`（[L1126-L1147](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1126-L1147)）等在调用 `llama_like` 时直接内联构造 `MoEConfig(num_experts=..., router=MoERouterConfig(top_k=...))`，展示工厂也能组装异构 block 内容。MoE 细节留待 u3-l5。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践（本讲正式实践任务）

**实践目标**：对比 `olmo2_1B` 与 `olmo3_1B` 工厂方法的差异（层数、注意力类型等）；再用 kwargs 把 `olmo2_14M` 改造成自定义小模型，`build()` 后统计参数量。

**操作步骤**：把下面的脚本存为 `OLMo-core-tutorial/preset_lab.py`（示例代码），在仓库根目录运行 `python -I OLMo-core-tutorial/preset_lab.py`（需要已按 u1-l2 完成开发安装）：

```python
# preset_lab.py（示例代码）
from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig

VOCAB = 50_304  # 任意演示词表大小

# ── 第 1 步：对比 olmo2_1B 与 olmo3_1B ──
for tag, cfg in [
    ("olmo2_1B", TransformerConfig.olmo2_1B(vocab_size=VOCAB)),
    ("olmo3_1B", TransformerConfig.olmo3_1B(vocab_size=VOCAB)),
]:
    attn = cfg.block.sequence_mixer  # 单 block 预设可直接取
    print(f"[{tag}]")
    print(f"  d_model={cfg.d_model}  n_layers={cfg.n_layers}")
    print(f"  n_heads={attn.n_heads}  n_kv_heads={attn.n_kv_heads}"
          f"  backend={attn.backend}")
    print(f"  ffn_hidden={cfg.block.feed_forward.hidden_size}")
    print(f"  sliding_window={attn.sliding_window}")
    print(f"  num_params={cfg.num_params:,}"
          f"  non_embedding={cfg.num_non_embedding_params:,}")

# ── 第 2 步：kwargs 定制 olmo2_14M ──
custom = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(
    vocab_size=VOCAB,
    n_layers=6,  # 4 -> 6
    n_heads=4,   # 8 -> 4（head_dim 在构建期推导为 128 // 4 = 32）
)
attn = custom.block.sequence_mixer
print("[custom olmo2_14M]")
print(f"  d_model={custom.d_model}  n_layers={custom.n_layers}"
      f"  n_heads={attn.n_heads}  ffn_hidden={custom.block.feed_forward.hidden_size}")
print(f"  预算 num_params={custom.num_params:,}")

model = custom.build()  # CPU 上直接构建
actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f"  实际 num_params={actual:,}  一致: {custom.num_params == actual}")
```

**需要观察的现象**与**预期结果**（依据源码可推导的部分）：

- `d_model` 两者都是 2048；**`n_layers` 不同：olmo2_1B 为 18，olmo3_1B 为 16**（前者走 `llama2_1B` 默认，后者走 `olmo2_1B_v2` 默认）。
- 两者 `n_heads=16`、`n_kv_heads=None`（留空表示 MHA，构建期才展开为 16）；FFN 宽度按 4.3.2 的公式都推得 8192。
- **注意力配置是最大差异**：`olmo2_1B` 的 `backend` 为 `None`（构建时自动选择）、`sliding_window=None`（全程全注意力）；`olmo3_1B` 显式 `backend=flash_2`，且 `sliding_window.pattern=[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]`——16 层下全注意力层为 3、7、11、15（推导见 4.3.3 ②）。
- 第 2 步：定制后 `n_layers=6`、`n_heads=4`；`olmo2_14M` 未指定 multiplier，FFN 宽度按 \(h = 256 \cdot \lceil \lfloor 8 \cdot 128 / 3 \rfloor / 256 \rceil = 256 \cdot \lceil 341/256 \rceil = 512\) 推得 512。
- 最后一行应打印 `一致: True`（有 [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L88-L93](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L88-L93) 的同类断言背书）。
- 两个配置的具体参数量数值与脚本输出**待本地验证**。

顺带一提：`config_test.py` 中的 `test_load_olmo3_7b_config`（[src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py:L14-L30](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py#L14-L30)）会从真实 OLMo 3 7B checkpoint 下载 `config.json` 并还原成 `TransformerConfig`（`d_model=4096, n_layers=32`）——预置工厂与序列化体系共同保证了「官方模型 ↔ Config」的双向可追溯。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`olmo2_1B` 与 `olmo2_1B_v2` 有什么区别？`olmo3_1B` 基于哪一个？
**答案**：两者都委托 `llama2_1B`，但 `olmo2_1B` 用其默认 `n_layers=18`，`olmo2_1B_v2` 显式默认 `n_layers=16` 且对齐旧 OLMo trainer 的 1B（docstring 见 [L724-L731](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L724-L731)）。`olmo3_1B` 基于 `olmo2_1B_v2`（[L983](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L983)），所以也是 16 层。

**练习 2**：不实例化模型，如何知道 `olmo2_32B` 用了 GQA？FFN 宽度是多少？
**答案**：读工厂方法（[L788-L807](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L788-L807)）：`n_heads=40, n_kv_heads=8`，8 < 40 即 GQA。FFN 宽度代入公式：\(h_0=\lfloor 8 \cdot 5120/3 \rfloor=13653\)，乘 \(27648/13653.33\approx 2.025\) 后取整得 27647，对齐到 512 的倍数得 **27648**——multiplier 正是反着凑出来的。

**练习 3**：想给一个 olmo3 预设换掉注意力后端，该怎么做？
**答案**：工厂的 `attn_backend` 旋钮本身就是 kwargs 可覆盖的，例如 `TransformerConfig.olmo3_190M(vocab_size=..., attn_backend=AttentionBackendName.flash_3)`——每个 olmo3 工厂都用 `kwargs.pop("attn_backend", AttentionBackendName.flash_2)` 接收它（如 [L912](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L912)）。

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲三块知识串成一次「预设巡检 + 定制 + 序列化」的小任务。在 `OLMo-core-tutorial/` 下新建 `presets_tour.py`（示例代码）：

```python
# presets_tour.py（示例代码）
import json

from olmo_core.nn.attention import SlidingWindowAttentionConfig
from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig

VOCAB = 50_304

# 1) 巡检：把 olmo2 全阶梯的关键超参整理成表
sizes = ["olmo2_1M", "olmo2_14M", "olmo2_100M", "olmo2_190M", "olmo2_1B_v2"]
print(f"{'preset':<14}{'d_model':>8}{'layers':>7}{'heads':>6}{'ffn':>7}{'params':>14}")
for name in sizes:
    cfg = getattr(TransformerConfig, name)(vocab_size=VOCAB)
    print(f"{name:<14}{cfg.d_model:>8}{cfg.n_layers:>7}"
          f"{cfg.block.sequence_mixer.n_heads:>6}"
          f"{cfg.block.feed_forward.hidden_size:>7}{cfg.num_params:>14,}")

# 2) 定制：在 olmo2_190M 基础上加深 + 换滑窗模式
cfg = TransformerConfig.olmo2_190M(
    vocab_size=VOCAB,
    n_layers=16,
    sliding_window=SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(
        pattern=[2048, -1],                       # 1:1 交替：滑窗 / 全注意力
        force_full_attention_on_first_layer=True,
        force_full_attention_on_last_layer=True,
    ),
)

# 3) 序列化往返：定制结果应能无损存取（呼应 u2-l1 的 round-trip）
d = cfg.as_config_dict()
print(json.dumps(d, indent=2)[:400], "...")  # 检查 _CLASS_/type 线索与滑窗字段
cfg2 = TransformerConfig.from_dict(json.loads(json.dumps(d)))
print("round-trip 一致:", cfg2.as_config_dict() == d)

# 4) 参数量对账
model = cfg.build()
print("num_params 一致:", cfg.num_params == sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()))
```

任务要求：

1. 运行脚本，记录步骤 1 的表格——观察 d_model / n_layers / FFN 宽度如何随档位增长（各档 FFN 宽度可按 4.3.2 公式手工推导核对）。
2. 解释步骤 2 中 `pattern=[2048, -1]` 在 16 层下哪些层是全注意力（提示：首末层被强制全注意力，模式从第 1 层起循环——具体层数组合待本地验证，可与 `_get_window_size` 的推导对照）。
3. 确认步骤 3、4 都打印 `True`。若第 3 步为 `False`，说明序列化丢了信息，回头检查是不是传了不可 JSON 化的对象。

预期：四步全部成功即完成本任务；具体数值输出待本地验证。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `TransformerConfig` 是模型全部形状的图纸：5 个必填字段（`d_model`/`vocab_size`/`n_layers`/`block`/`lm_head`）定骨架，其余字段管 block 组织、初始化、词表与输出；构造时 `__post_init__` 即校验非法组合。
- `block` 有三种组织方式：单 block、命名 block + `block_pattern` 循环（混合架构用）、单 block + `block_overrides` 逐层覆盖；`resolved_block_configs` 把它们统一成「每层一个配置」的列表。
- `build()` 按 `name` 分发到 `Transformer`/`NormalizedTransformer`/`MoETransformer`，支持 `init_device="meta"` 占位与 `freeze_params` 通配冻结；`num_params` 是不实例化就精确成立的参数量预算（有测试断言背书）。
- 预置工厂是一座三层金字塔：规模档位（olmo2_1M…olmo2_32B、olmo3 系列）→ 架构预设（llama2/gemma3/qwen3…）→ 家族装配（`llama_like` 等）；**kwargs.pop + 向下透传**让一行调用既能选档位又能改任何深层参数。
- olmo3 预设 = 对应 olmo2 预设 + 滑窗模式 `[4096,4096,4096,-1]` + flash_2 后端；`olmo3_1B` 特例：基于 `olmo2_1B_v2`（16 层而非 18 层）。
- `with_rope_scaling` 展示了 Config 级组合子风格：返回改造后的副本，用 `block_overrides` 只放大全注意力层的 RoPE。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **下一讲 u3-l3（注意力机制与可插拔后端）**：本讲多次遇到 `attn_backend`、`sliding_window`、`qk_norm`，下一讲深入 `AttentionConfig` 背后的 `Attention` 基类与各后端实现。
- **u3-l4（核心组件）**：`FeedForwardConfig.hidden_size` 的宽度如何变成 SwiGLU 三矩阵、`LMHeadConfig` 与 `LayerNormConfig` 的字段含义。
- **u3-l6（模型初始化）**：本讲只点了 `init_method`/`init_std` 枚举，初始化方案如何按参数类型生效留到那讲展开。
- **延伸阅读源码**：通读 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py) 中你还没读过的工厂（`gemma3_like`、`llama_like_moe`），对照本文的三层金字塔模型检验你的理解。

When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

# 项目学习手册·单篇讲义生成 Worker

## 角色

你是资深技术教育专家、源码阅读导师和代码实践教练。

你运行在被分析项目的根目录内。

你可以使用：

- `Read`
- `Grep`
- `Glob`
- 只读 `git` 命令，例如 `git log`、`git diff`、`git show`、`git ls-files`

你可以写文件，但只能写入：

- `<项目名>-tutorial/`

你只能生成 stdin 指定的那一篇讲义。

禁止：

- 修改源码。
- 生成其他讲义。
- 修改 manifest。
- 写入讲义目录之外的文件。

---

## 总目标

根据 stdin 中给出的讲义规格，生成一篇适合学习手册的 Markdown 讲义。

讲义必须：

1. 全部使用中文。
2. 从零开始解释，不默认读者已经熟悉项目。
3. 结合真实源码讲解。
4. 包含可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 结构清晰，适合长期维护。
6. 对关键源码给出永久链接和行号。
7. 不编造不存在的代码、命令、接口或行为。

---

## 工作流程

生成讲义前，请按顺序完成：

1. 阅读 stdin 中的讲义规格。
2. 阅读 `source_files` 中列出的关键源码。
3. 如果源码不足，用 `Grep` / `Glob` 补充查找相关入口、测试、示例和调用链。
4. 确认本讲义的最小模块。
5. 根据 action 执行：

   - `new`：从零创建该讲义。
   - `rebuild`：从零重建该讲义。
   - `update`：先读取已有讲义，再结合 diff 更新。
   - `keep`：如果被调用，通常不需要编辑文件，只做简短说明。

---

## update 模式规则

当 action 为 `update` 时：

1. 先 `Read` 当前已有的讲义文件。
2. 使用 `git diff previous_head..current_head` 查看相关代码变化。
3. 更新已经失效的源码说明。
4. 刷新所有永久链接中的 head 和行号。
5. 保留仍然正确的内容。
6. 新增必要解释和实践步骤。
7. 如果核心流程已经变化，可以重写受影响章节。

---

## 讲义标准结构

每篇讲义必须使用下面的结构。

```md
# 讲义标题

## 1. 本讲目标

说明读者学完后应该掌握什么。

## 2. 前置知识

用通俗语言解释本讲需要的基础概念。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

列出本讲涉及的关键文件，并说明每个文件的作用。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

按最小模块拆分。

每个最小模块都必须包含：

### 4.x 模块名称

#### 4.x.1 概念说明

解释这个模块是什么、解决什么问题、为什么需要它。

#### 4.x.2 核心流程

用列表、流程图式文字或伪代码描述执行过程。

如涉及算法、协议、并发、缓存、调度、状态机等，可以补充必要数学或原理说明。

数学公式使用：

- 行内：\( ... \)
- 独立公式：\[ ... \]

不要使用 `$...$`。

#### 4.x.3 源码精读

引用真实项目代码。

每个关键代码点都要给出永久链接，格式为：

[文件路径:L起始-L结束](<permalink_base>/<相对路径>#L起始-L结束)

链接旁边必须用中文说明这段代码做了什么。

#### 4.x.4 代码实践

给出一个可操作的小实践，例如：

- 运行一个示例。
- 阅读一个测试。
- 修改一个配置。
- 添加一行日志。
- 改一个参数观察行为。
- 编写一个最小调用示例。
- 跟踪一条调用链。

实践步骤要包含：

1. 实践目标。
2. 操作步骤。
3. 需要观察的现象。
4. 预期结果。
5. 如果无法确定运行结果，明确写「待本地验证」。

不要假装已经运行过命令。

#### 4.x.5 小练习与答案

给出 2 到 3 个练习题，并直接给出参考答案。
```

---

## 讲义结尾必须包含

```md
## 5. 综合实践

设计一个贯穿本讲主要内容的小任务，帮助读者把知识串起来。

## 6. 本讲小结

用 3 到 6 条 bullet 总结本讲。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

说明下一讲应该学习什么，或者建议读者继续阅读哪些源码。
```

---

## 代码实践要求

每篇讲义至少包含一个完整代码实践。

实践优先从以下位置寻找依据：

- README
- examples
- tests
- scripts
- package scripts
- Makefile
- CI 配置
- 项目已有 demo

如果找不到可运行示例，也必须提供「源码阅读型实践」，例如：

- 跟踪函数调用链。
- 根据测试断言理解行为。
- 修改局部参数并说明应该观察什么。
- 给关键函数添加日志。
- 阅读配置加载过程并画出流程。

---

## 源码引用要求

- 只引用实际存在的文件。
- 行号必须准确。
- 永久链接必须使用当前 HEAD。
- 如果无法确认行号，不要编造，标注「待确认」。
- 示例代码如果不是项目原有代码，必须明确标注为「示例代码」。

---

## 写作风格

- 中文。
- 深入浅出。
- 先讲直觉，再讲源码。
- 多使用标题、列表、表格和伪代码。
- 不要写空泛总结。
- 不要堆砌大段源码。
- 代码片段要短，只保留关键部分。
- 对初学者不熟悉的术语要解释。

---

## 输出与写入规则

- 只写 stdin 指定的文件。
- 文件路径必须是 `<项目名>-tutorial/<filename>`。
- 不要写其他文件。
- 不要修改源码。
- 完成后，用一句话总结本讲义覆盖了哪些最小模块。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

schema.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

content.content:
1	# TransformerConfig 与预置架构工厂方法
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	上一讲（u3-l1）我们读了 `Transformer` 与 `TransformerBlock` 的前向主链路，知道了数据如何从 `input_ids` 一路流到 logits。本讲把视角拉回到「模型是怎么被描述出来的」：
6	
7	1. 读懂 `TransformerConfig` 中每个字段对应的模型结构含义——看完你就知道一张「模型图纸」上到底画了哪些信息。
8	2. 会用 `olmo2_190M()`、`olmo3_7B()` 这类预置工厂方法快速构建模型配置，并说清楚 olmo2 与 olmo3 预设的差别。
9	3. 掌握贯穿全库的复用模式：**Config 工厂方法 + kwargs 覆盖**——一行调用既能选定规模档位，又能随手改掉任何深层参数。
10	4. 理解 `build()` 如何从图纸初始化出一个真实模型，以及 `num_params` 如何在建模之前就精确算出参数量。
11	
12	## 2. 前置知识
13	
14	本讲假设你已读过：
15	
16	- **u2-l1 / u2-l2**：`Config` 是可序列化的嵌套 dataclass，`ModuleConfig` 提供抽象的 `build()`，`ModelConfig` 再加上 `num_params` 等属性。`TransformerConfig` 正是这条继承链的成员。
17	- **u3-l1**：`Transformer` 顶层只做编排，`n_layers` 个 `TransformerBlock` 堆叠在残差流上；OLMo 2 默认 block 是 `reordered_norm`（norm 在子层输出侧）。
18	
19	几个本讲反复出现的术语，先用一句话解释：
20	
21	| 术语 | 含义 |
22	| --- | --- |
23	| `d_model` | 残差流宽度（隐藏维度）。中间所有层都保持这个宽度，形状只在 embedding 入口和 lm_head 出口变化。 |
24	| `n_heads` / `n_kv_heads` | 查询头数 / 键值头数。`n_kv_heads < n_heads` 时就是 **GQA**（分组查询注意力，多组 Q 共享一组 KV，省 KV cache 与投影参数）；`n_kv_heads` 留空（`None`）表示等于 `n_heads`，即标准 MHA。 |
25	| `head_dim` | 每个注意力头的维度。留空时在构建期推导为 `d_model // n_heads`（见 [src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py:L700-L704](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L700-L704)）。部分模型（如 Qwen3）会显式指定与 `d_model // n_heads` 不同的 `head_dim`。 |
26	| FFN hidden size | 前馈网络（SwiGLU）中间层宽度。`llama_like` 里由 `d_model` 乘系数推导（见 4.3.3）。 |
27	| `reordered_norm` | OLMo 2 的 block 布局：两个 LayerNorm 放在注意力/FFN 的输出侧（post-norm 风格）。 |
28	| RoPE `theta` | 旋转位置编码的基频，越大越适合长上下文（OLMo 2/3 用 500 000，Qwen3 用 1 000 000）。 |
29	| 参数量预算 | `num_params`：不实例化模型，仅凭 Config 算出的精确参数总数。 |
30	
31	## 3. 本讲源码地图
32	
33	| 文件 | 作用 |

43	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
44	
45	### 4.1 TransformerConfig：一张描述模型全部形状的图纸
46	
47	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
48	
49	u3-l1 里我们直接读了 `Transformer` 类的 `__init__` 参数——那有十几个位置参数，手工拼装既繁琐又容易错。`TransformerConfig` 解决的就是这个问题：把「造一个 Transformer 需要知道的一切」收进一个可序列化、可校验、可复用的 dataclass。
50	
51	它的设计要点：
52	
53	1. **复合配置**：`TransformerConfig` 不重复定义注意力、FFN、LayerNorm 的细节，而是嵌套持有 `TransformerBlockConfig`、`LMHeadConfig` 等子配置——这正是 u2-l1 讲过的「Config 嵌套组合」模式。
54	2. **顶层管形状，block 管内部**：`d_model`、`n_layers` 这类全局量在顶层；每个 block 内部用什么注意力、什么 FFN 由 `TransformerBlockConfig` 描述。
55	3. **构造即校验**：`__post_init__` 在对象诞生时就拒绝非法组合（比如 `tie_word_embeddings` 搭配 normalized transformer）。
56	
57	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
58	
59	`TransformerConfig` 的字段可以分成四组来记：
60	
61	```text
62	┌─ 形状骨架 ─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
63	│  d_model / vocab_size / n_layers                        │
64	├─ block 的组织方式 ──────────────────────────────────────┤
65	│  block（单个 或 dict[str, 多个命名 block]）              │
66	│  block_pattern（命名 block 的循环模式）                   │
67	│  block_overrides（按层号覆盖单 block）                    │
68	├─ 初始化 ────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
69	│  init_method / init_seed / init_std / embedding_init_std │
70	│  dtype / freeze_params                                  │
71	├─ 词表与输出 ────────────────────────────────────────────┤
72	│  lm_head / embedding_norm / embed_scale                 │
73	│  tie_word_embeddings / n_extra_vocab                    │
74	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
75	```
76	
77	构造流程：`TransformerConfig(...)` → dataclass 赋值 → `__post_init__` 校验 → 得到一个可 `build()`、可 `as_config_dict()` 序列化的纯数据对象。
78	
79	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
80	
81	**① 继承链与字段定义。** `TransformerConfig` 继承 `ModelConfig`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L335-L362](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L335-L362)）：前五个字段 `d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 没有默认值，是必填项；其余都有默认值。注意 `block` 字段的类型是联合类型 `TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig]`——这正是 4.2 节「block 三种组织方式」的入口。`name: TransformerType = TransformerType.default` 决定顶层用哪个实现类（default → `Transformer`，normalized → nGPT，moe → `MoETransformer`，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L80-L103](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L80-L103)）。
82	
83	**② `__post_init__` 校验。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L372-L397](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L372-L397) 依次检查：normalized transformer 不许 tie 词嵌入；`n_extra_vocab` 非负且只支持 default 类型；然后调用 `validate_block_resolution_config` 确保 `block` / `block_pattern` / `block_overrides` 三者组合合法（细节见 4.2.3）。若 `n_layers` 不能被 `block_pattern` 长度整除，只发 warning 不报错——模式会循环后截断。
84	
85	**③ `TransformerBlockConfig` 的字段。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L162-L212](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L162-L212)：
86	
87	- `sequence_mixer`：序列混合器配置（通常是 `AttentionConfig`，也可以是 `GatedDeltaNetConfig` 等线性注意力——Qwen3.5 预设就是这么用的）。它是唯一必填字段。
88	- `attention`：已废弃的 `InitVar`，仅为兼容旧配置保留；`__post_init__` 里会把它搬到 `sequence_mixer`（[L214-L226](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L214-L226)）。
89	- `layer_norm` / `feed_forward` / `feed_forward_moe`：dense block 需要 `feed_forward`，MoE block 需要 `feed_forward_moe`，hybrid MoE 则两者都有。
90	- `name: TransformerBlockType`：选 block 布局（default / reordered_norm / peri_norm / moe 系列等，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L106-L159](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L106-L159)）。
91	- `dropout` / `masked_dropout` / `attention_residual_alpha` / `feed_forward_residual_alpha`：正则与残差缩放的可选项。
92	
93	**④ 基类契约。** `ModuleConfig` 只要求一个抽象 `build()`（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L9-L16](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L9-L16)）；`ModelConfig` 再要求 `num_params`、`num_non_embedding_params` 两个抽象属性（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L19-L43](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L19-L43)）。`TransformerConfig` 把这些全部实现了。
94
