148	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
149	
150	**练习 1**：`TransformerConfig` 有约 18 个字段，为什么只有 5 个必填？
151	**答案**：`d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 定义了模型的最小形状骨架，库无法替你猜；其余字段（dtype、init 系列、tie_word_embeddings 等）都有合理默认值，属于「可选微调」。
152	
153	**练习 2**：`TransformerBlockConfig.sequence_mixer` 为什么不叫 `attention`？
154	**答案**：因为序列混合器是一个可替换插槽——大多数预设放 `AttentionConfig`，但 Qwen3.5 等混合架构会放 `GatedDeltaNetConfig`（线性注意力）。旧名 `attention` 保留为废弃的 `InitVar` 仅为加载旧配置（见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L172-L177](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L172-L177)）。
155	
156	**练习 3**：`n_extra_vocab` 字段是给谁用的？
157	**答案**：给 Molmo2 多模态模型——把 128 个图像专用 token 作为**独立参数**追加到 embedding 表后面；这些 token 只作为输入、永远不是预测目标（字段文档见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L362-L370](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L362-L370)）。
158	
159	### 4.2 从图纸到模型：block 解析、`build()` 与参数量预算
160	
161	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
162	
163	图纸画好后有两个问题：`block` 字段允许「单 block」「命名 block + 模式」「单 block + 逐层覆盖」三种写法，`build()` 前要先统一成「每层一个 `TransformerBlockConfig`」的列表；此外，我们希望**不实例化模型就能知道参数量**——这对实验规划（显存预算、优化器状态估算）非常重要。
164	
165	这两个需求分别由 `resolve_block_configs()` 与 `num_params` 属性满足。`num_params` 是纯算术：各子配置都实现了自己的 `num_params(d_model)`，顶层把它们加总。测试保证了它与真实参数量分毫不差。
166	
167	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
168	
169	**block 解析**（伪代码）：
170	
171	```text
172	resolve_block_configs(n_layers, block, block_pattern, block_overrides):
173	    若 block 是 dict（命名 block）:
174	        pattern 按 cycle 循环，截取前 n_layers 项
175	        返回 [block[name] for name in 截取后的 pattern]
176	    否则（单 block）:
177	        结果 = [block] * n_layers
178	        对 block_overrides 中的每个 (层号, 覆盖配置): 结果[层号] = 覆盖配置
179	        返回 结果
180	```
181	
182	**`build()` 流程**：
183	
184	1. 先打印参数量预算日志；
185	2. 按 `self.name` 分发到 `Transformer` / `NormalizedTransformer` / `MoETransformer` 构造函数（`moe_fused_v2` 直接抛 `RuntimeError`，要求改用 `OLMoDDPModelConfig`）；
186	3. 若设置了 `freeze_params`，用 `fnmatch` 逐个参数名匹配并置 `requires_grad=False`；
187	4. 打印模型摘要，返回模型。
188	
189	**参数量公式**（对应 `num_params` 属性的求和顺序）：
190	
191	\[
192	N_{\text{total}} = \underbrace{d \cdot V}_{\text{embedding}} + \underbrace{N_{\text{norm}}^{emb}}_{\text{embedding norm}} + \sum_{i=1}^{L} N_{\text{block}}^{(i)}(d) + \underbrace{N_{\text{lm\_head}}(d, V)}_{\text{输出头}} - \mathbb{1}_{\text{tied}} \cdot d \cdot V
193	\]
194	
195	其中 \(d\) 为 `d_model`，\(V\) 为 `vocab_size`，\(L\) 为 `n_layers`；最后一项表示 tie 词嵌入时 lm_head 与 embedding 共享权重，要减去一份。而**非嵌入参数量**就是：
196	
197	\[
198	N_{\text{non-emb}} = N_{\text{total}} - d \cdot V
199	\]
200	
201	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
202	
203	**① block 解析。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L2176-L2206](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2176-L2206) 是 `resolve_block_configs`：dict 分支用 `islice(cycle(block_pattern), n_layers)` 把模式循环截断到 `n_layers` 长；单 block 分支先铺满再应用 `block_overrides`。配套的 `validate_block_resolution_config`（[L2144-L2173](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2144-L2173)）负责拒绝非法组合：dict 必须配 pattern、dict 不许再用 overrides、pattern 里的名字必须都在 dict 中。顶层属性 `resolved_block_configs`（[L497-L504](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L497-L504)）就是对这个函数的封装。
204	
205	**② `build()`。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L399-L495](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L399-L495)。注意两个细节：其一，`init_device` 参数（[L399-L409](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L399-L409)）默认 `"cpu"`，分布式训练时通常传 `"meta"`——这就是 u1-l4 说过的「模型先在 meta 设备占位，再由并行策略落位」；其二，`freeze_params` 的 fnmatch 匹配循环（[L477-L485](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L477-L485)）支持 `*"wq"` 这类通配符按参数名冻结。
206	
207	**③ 参数量预算。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L506-L529](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L506-L529) 严格按上面公式求和；`num_non_embedding_params`（[L556-L561](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L556-L561)）就是简单相减。block 一侧的 `TransformerBlockConfig.num_params(d_model)`（[L295-L322](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L295-L322)）把序列混合器、两个 norm、FFN/MoE 逐项相加——标准 block 恰好计两次 `layer_norm`（注意力一次、FFN 一次），与 reordered_norm 布局里每 block 两个 norm 对应。MoE 场景还有 `num_active_params`（每 token 实际激活的参数量，[L531-L554](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L531-L554)），这是评估 MoE 推理/训练成本时更贴心的指标。
208	
209	**④ 测试证据。** `test_small_llama2_builder_config`（[src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L82-L105](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L82-L105)）构建 `llama2_271M` 后逐参数 `numel()` 求和，并断言 `config.num_params == num_actual_params == model.num_params` 三者相等——预算不是估算，是精确值。
210	
211	#### 4.2.4 代码实践
212	
213	**实践目标**：验证「参数量预算 = 真实参数量」，并体会 `block_overrides` 的用法。
214	
215	**操作步骤**（示例代码）：
216	
217	```python
218	from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig
219	
220	cfg = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(vocab_size=1_000)
221	print(f"预算: total={cfg.num_params:,}  non-emb={cfg.num_non_embedding_params:,}")
222	
223	model = cfg.build()  # CPU 构建
224	actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
225	print(f"实际: {actual:,}  相等: {cfg.num_params == actual}")
226	
227	# block_overrides：把第 0 层换成带 dropout 的副本
228	block0 = cfg.block.copy()
229	block0.dropout = 0.1
230	cfg2 = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(vocab_size=1_000, block_overrides={0: block0})
231	print(f"覆盖后层数不变: {len(cfg2.resolved_block_configs)}")
232	print(f"第 0 层 dropout={cfg2.resolved_block_configs[0].dropout}, "
233	      f"第 1 层 dropout={cfg2.resolved_block_configs[1].dropout}")
234	```
235	
236	**需要观察的现象**：预算与实际参数量相等；`resolved_block_configs` 长度等于 `n_layers`，且只有第 0 层的 dropout 被改成 0.1，其余层仍是 `None`。
237	
238	**预期结果**：两行 `相等: True`、`dropout=0.1` 与 `dropout=None`。参数量数值待本地验证。
239	
240	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
241	
242	**练习 1**：为什么 `tie_word_embeddings=True` 时 `num_params` 要减去 `d_model * vocab_size`？
243	**答案**：tie 意味着 lm_head 与 embedding 共享同一份权重张量，`named_parameters()` 里只会出现一次；求和时却分别计入了 embedding 和 lm_head 两份，必须扣除一份（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L526-L527](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L526-L527)）。
244	
245	**练习 2**：`resolved_block_configs` 是普通字段还是 property？为什么？
246	**答案**：是 property（[L497-L504](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L497-L504)）。因为它依赖 `n_layers`/`block`/`block_pattern`/`block_overrides` 四个字段的组合结果，若存成字段，任何一个字段被修改后都可能过期；property 每次现算，永远一致。
247	
248	**练习 3**：`build()` 里 `name=TransformerType.moe_fused_v2` 会发生什么？
249	**答案**：抛出 `RuntimeError("Use OLMoDDPModelConfig")`（[L472-L473](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L472-L473)）。融合 MoE-v2 模型要用 `TransformerConfig` 的子类 `OLMoDDPModelConfig`（[L2052-L2141](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2052-L2141)），它自带重计算、双 batch 重叠等额外开关——这也是「通过子类扩展 Config」的范例。
250	
251	### 4.3 预置架构工厂方法：olmo2 阶梯与 llama_like 复用模式
252	
253	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
254	
255	手写 `TransformerConfig` 太繁琐，而且 OLMo 2、OLMo 3、Llama、Qwen 等架构的正确超参组合本身就值得沉淀。`TransformerConfig` 上挂了三类 `classmethod` 工厂：
256	
257	1. **规模档位工厂**：`olmo2_14M()`、`olmo2_190M()`、`olmo2_1B()`……名字是规模档位（配 OLMo 词表时的名义参数量级），从 1M 一路到 32B。
258	2. **家族装配工厂**：`llama_like()`、`ngpt_like()`、`gemma3_like()`、`qwen3_5_like()`——把一组超参翻译成完整的嵌套 Config 树。
259	3. **Config 级组合子**：`with_rope_scaling()` 这类「拿一个现成配置、返回改造后副本」的方法。
260	
261	这些工厂共享同一个复用哲学——**工厂方法 + kwargs 覆盖**：每个工厂只 `pop` 自己关心的少数旋钮并给出默认值，把剩余 `**kwargs` 原样向下游传递，最终汇入 `cls(...)`。于是 `olmo2_190M(vocab_size=..., n_layers=2, sliding_window=...)` 一次调用中：`n_layers` 在 190M 这层被吃掉、`sliding_window` 被透传给 `llama_like`——测试代码 [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L181-L205](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L181-L205) 的 `get_transformer_config` 就是这种一行式调用的活例子。
262	
263	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
264	
265	工厂调用是一座三层金字塔：
266	
267	```text
268	TransformerConfig.olmo3_1B(vocab_size, **kwargs)     ← 规模档位（olmo3 = olmo2 + 滑窗 + flash_2）
269	        │  委托
270	        ▼
271	TransformerConfig.olmo2_1B_v2(vocab_size, **kwargs)  ← 规模档位（指定 n_layers=16）
272	        │  委托
273	        ▼
274	TransformerConfig.llama2_1B(vocab_size, **kwargs)    ← 架构预设（d_model=2048 等）
275	        │  委托
276	        ▼
277	TransformerConfig.llama_like(**所有参数)              ← 家族装配：拼出 block / lm_head / 子配置
278	        │  cls(...)
279	        ▼
280	TransformerConfig 实例
281	```
282	
283	`llama_like` 内部决定 FFN 宽度的规则是（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1723-L1727](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1723-L1727)）：
284	
285	\[
286	h_0 = \left\lfloor \frac{8d}{3} \right\rfloor,\qquad
287	h_1 = \lfloor m \cdot h_0 \rfloor,\qquad
288	h = k \cdot \left\lceil \frac{h_1}{k} \right\rceil
289	\]
290	
291	其中 \(d\) 是 `d_model`，\(m\) 是可选的 `hidden_size_multiplier`，\(k\) 是 `hidden_size_multiple_of`（默认 256，`ensure_multiple_of` 见 [src/olmo_core/utils.py:L903-L904](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/utils.py#L903-L904)）。例：`d=2048, m=1.5` 时 \(h_0=5461\)，\(h_1=8191\)，对齐到 256 的倍数得 \(h=8192\)。
292	
293	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
294	
295	**① olmo2 规模阶梯。** 每个档位都是对 `llama_like` 的一次参数化调用。以 `olmo2_190M` 为例（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L647-L660](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L647-L660)）：`d_model=768`、`hidden_size_multiplier=1.5`、`n_layers=12`、`n_heads=12`，并统一 `block_name=reordered_norm`、`qk_norm=True`、`rope_theta=500_000`、`layer_norm_eps=1e-6`。`olmo2_14M`（[L586-L598](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L586-L598)）则是 `d_model=128, n_layers=4, n_heads=8`。较大档位改为委托给 llama2 预设：`olmo2_1B` → `llama2_1B`（[L707-L722](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L707-L722)，默认 `n_layers=18`）；`olmo2_7B` → `llama2_7B`（[L760-L772](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L760-L772)）。`olmo2_32B`（[L788-L807](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L788-L807)）值得细看：`d_model=5120, n_layers=64, n_heads=40, n_kv_heads=8`（GQA），且 `hidden_size_multiplier=27648/(8·5120/3)`、`hidden_size_multiple_of=512`——代入公式恰好凑出 FFN 宽度 27648。
296	
297	**② olmo3 = olmo2 + 滑窗注意力 + flash_2。** 全部 `olmo3_*` 工厂结构一致，以 `olmo3_1B` 为例（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L978-L996](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L978-L996)）：调用对应的 olmo2 工厂（注意是 `olmo2_1B_v2`，默认 `n_layers=16`，而非 `olmo2_1B` 的 18 层！），再追加两样东西——`sliding_window=SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(force_full_attention_on_first_layer=False, force_full_attention_on_last_layer=True, pattern=[4096, 4096, 4096, -1])` 和 `attn_backend=flash_2`。滑窗语义见字段文档（[src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py:L252-L269](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L252-L269)）：`-1` 表示全注意力，即每 4 层里前 3 层只看 4096 窗口、第 4 层全局；`_get_window_size`（[L271-L291](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L271-L291)）还处理首末层的强制规则。对 16 层的 olmo3_1B 推导一遍：首层不强制全注意力、末层（第 15 层）强制，模式从第 0 层开始循环——全注意力层为 3、7、11、15。另注意 `olmo3_600M` 是唯一还改了 `d_model`（1280）的例外（[L944](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L944)）。
298	
299	**③ `llama_like` 装配主体。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1676-L1800](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1676-L1800)：先算 FFN 宽度（L1723-1727），再配全局 LayerNorm（默认 `rms`，`fused_ops=True` 时 `fused_rms`，L1729-1737），然后决定注意力实现（`fused_ops` 且无 GQA 时自动切 `fused_v2` + flash_2 后端，L1739-1747），拼出单个 `TransformerBlockConfig`（L1753-1779），最后 `cls(...)` 落成 `TransformerConfig`（L1791-1800）。中间的 `block_mods` 钩子（L1781-1789）允许按层号传入「改 block 配置的函数」，比 `block_overrides` 更 programmable，两者互斥。
300	
301	**④ 混合架构与命名 block。** `qwen3_5_like`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L1584-L1674](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1584-L1674)）构造两种 block——`gdn`（GatedDeltaNet 线性注意力）与 `attn`（全注意力），以 `block={"gdn": ..., "attn": ...}` + `block_pattern=["gdn","gdn","gdn","attn"]` 的 3:1 模式组装；`gemma3_like`（[L1910-L2003](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1910-L2003)）同样用 `local`/`global` 两种 block 按 5:1 循环，并设置 `embed_scale=sqrt(d_model)`。这就是 `block` 字段允许 dict 的意义。
302	
303	**⑤ Config 级组合子。** `with_rope_scaling`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L2005-L2049](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2005-L2049)）返回配置副本，把 RoPE 缩放只加在全注意力层（滑窗层跳过），实现方式正是批量生成 `block_overrides`——长上下文训练脚本靠它在中期扩展上下文。
304	
305	**⑥ MoE 预设。** `smallmoe`（[L1078-L1100](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1078-L1100)）、`olmoe_1B_7B`（[L1126-L1147](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L1126-L1147)）等在调用 `llama_like` 时直接内联构造 `MoEConfig(num_experts=..., router=MoERouterConfig(top_k=...))`，展示工厂也能组装异构 block 内容。MoE 细节留待 u3-l5。
306	
307	#### 4.3.4 代码实践（本讲正式实践任务）
308	
309	**实践目标**：对比 `olmo2_1B` 与 `olmo3_1B` 工厂方法的差异（层数、注意力类型等）；再用 kwargs 把 `olmo2_14M` 改造成自定义小模型，`build()` 后统计参数量。
310	
311	**操作步骤**：把下面的脚本存为 `OLMo-core-tutorial/preset_lab.py`（示例代码），在仓库根目录运行 `python -I OLMo-core-tutorial/preset_lab.py`（需要已按 u1-l2 完成开发安装）：
312	
313	```python
314	# preset_lab.py（示例代码）
315	from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig
316	
317	VOCAB = 50_304  # 任意演示词表大小
318	
319	# ── 第 1 步：对比 olmo2_1B 与 olmo3_1B ──
320	for tag, cfg in [
321	    ("olmo2_1B", TransformerConfig.olmo2_1B(vocab_size=VOCAB)),
322	    ("olmo3_1B", TransformerConfig.olmo3_1B(vocab_size=VOCAB)),
323	]:
324	    attn = cfg.block.sequence_mixer  # 单 block 预设可直接取
325	    print(f"[{tag}]")
326	    print(f"  d_model={cfg.d_model}  n_layers={cfg.n_layers}")
327	    print(f"  n_heads={attn.n_heads}  n_kv_heads={attn.n_kv_heads}"
328	          f"  backend={attn.backend}")
329	    print(f"  ffn_hidden={cfg.block.feed_forward.hidden_size}")
330	    print(f"  sliding_window={attn.sliding_window}")
331	    print(f"  num_params={cfg.num_params:,}"
332	          f"  non_embedding={cfg.num_non_embedding_params:,}")
333	
334	# ── 第 2 步：kwargs 定制 olmo2_14M ──
335	custom = TransformerConfig.olmo2_14M(
336	    vocab_size=VOCAB,
337	    n_layers=6,  # 4 -> 6
338	    n_heads=4,   # 8 -> 4（head_dim 在构建期推导为 128 // 4 = 32）
339	)
340	attn = custom.block.sequence_mixer
341	print("[custom olmo2_14M]")
342	print(f"  d_model={custom.d_model}  n_layers={custom.n_layers}"
343	      f"  n_heads={attn.n_heads}  ffn_hidden={custom.block.feed_forward.hidden_size}")
344	print(f"  预算 num_params={custom.num_params:,}")
345	
346	model = custom.build()  # CPU 上直接构建
347	actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
348	print(f"  实际 num_params={actual:,}  一致: {custom.num_params == actual}")
349	```
350	
351	**需要观察的现象**与**预期结果**（依据源码可推导的部分）：
352	
353	- `d_model` 两者都是 2048；**`n_layers` 不同：olmo2_1B 为 18，olmo3_1B 为 16**（前者走 `llama2_1B` 默认，后者走 `olmo2_1B_v2` 默认）。
354	- 两者 `n_heads=16`、`n_kv_heads=None`（留空表示 MHA，构建期才展开为 16）；FFN 宽度按 4.3.2 的公式都推得 8192。
355	- **注意力配置是最大差异**：`olmo2_1B` 的 `backend` 为 `None`（构建时自动选择）、`sliding_window=None`（全程全注意力）；`olmo3_1B` 显式 `backend=flash_2`，且 `sliding_window.pattern=[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]`——16 层下全注意力层为 3、7、11、15（推导见 4.3.3 ②）。
356	- 第 2 步：定制后 `n_layers=6`、`n_heads=4`；`olmo2_14M` 未指定 multiplier，FFN 宽度按 \(h = 256 \cdot \lceil \lfloor 8 \cdot 128 / 3 \rfloor / 256 \rceil = 256 \cdot \lceil 341/256 \rceil = 512\) 推得 512。
357	- 最后一行应打印 `一致: True`（有 [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py:L88-L93](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py#L88-L93) 的同类断言背书）。
358	- 两个配置的具体参数量数值与脚本输出**待本地验证**。
359	
360	顺带一提：`config_test.py` 中的 `test_load_olmo3_7b_config`（[src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py:L14-L30](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py#L14-L30)）会从真实 OLMo 3 7B checkpoint 下载 `config.json` 并还原成 `TransformerConfig`（`d_model=4096, n_layers=32`）——预置工厂与序列化体系共同保证了「官方模型 ↔ Config」的双向可追溯。
361	
362	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
363	
364	**练习 1**：`olmo2_1B` 与 `olmo2_1B_v2` 有什么区别？`olmo3_1B` 基于哪一个？
365	**答案**：两者都委托 `llama2_1B`，但 `olmo2_1B` 用其默认 `n_layers=18`，`olmo2_1B_v2` 显式默认 `n_layers=16` 且对齐旧 OLMo trainer 的 1B（docstring 见 [L724-L731](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L724-L731)）。`olmo3_1B` 基于 `olmo2_1B_v2`（[L983](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L983)），所以也是 16 层。
366	
367	**练习 2**：不实例化模型，如何知道 `olmo2_32B` 用了 GQA？FFN 宽度是多少？
368	**答案**：读工厂方法（[L788-L807](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L788-L807)）：`n_heads=40, n_kv_heads=8`，8 < 40 即 GQA。FFN 宽度代入公式：\(h_0=\lfloor 8 \cdot 5120/3 \rfloor=13653\)，乘 \(27648/13653.33\approx 2.025\) 后取整得 27647，对齐到 512 的倍数得 **27648**——multiplier 正是反着凑出来的。
369	
370	**练习 3**：想给一个 olmo3 预设换掉注意力后端，该怎么做？
371	**答案**：工厂的 `attn_backend` 旋钮本身就是 kwargs 可覆盖的，例如 `TransformerConfig.olmo3_190M(vocab_size=..., attn_backend=AttentionBackendName.flash_3)`——每个 olmo3 工厂都用 `kwargs.pop("attn_backend", AttentionBackendName.flash_2)` 接收它（如 [L912](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/075a7892d8a004242b085bf3c71b996389fd863c/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L912)）。
372	
373	## 5. 综合实践
374	
375	把本讲三块知识串成一次「预设巡检 + 定制 + 序列化」的小任务。在 `OLMo-core-tutorial/` 下新建 `presets_tour.py`（示例代码）：
376	
377	```python
378	# presets_tour.py（示例代码）
379	import json
380	
381	from olmo_core.nn.attention import SlidingWindowAttentionConfig
382	from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerConfig
383	
384	VOCAB = 50_304
385	
386	# 1) 巡检：把 olmo2 全阶梯的关键超参整理成表
387	sizes = ["olmo2_1M", "olmo2_14M", "olmo2_100M", "olmo2_190M", "olmo2_1B_v2"]
388	print(f"{'preset':<14}{'d_model':>8}{'layers':>7}{'heads':>6}{'ffn':>7}{'params':>14}")
389	for name in sizes:
390	    cfg = getattr(TransformerConfig, name)(vocab_size=VOCAB)
391	    print(f"{name:<14}{cfg.d_model:>8}{cfg.n_layers:>7}"
392	          f"{cfg.block.sequence_mixer.n_heads:>6}"
393	          f"{cfg.block.feed_forward.hidden_size:>7}{cfg.num_params:>14,}")
394	
395	# 2) 定制：在 olmo2_190M 基础上加深 + 换滑窗模式
396	cfg = TransformerConfig.olmo2_190M(
397	    vocab_size=VOCAB,
398	    n_layers=16,
399	    sliding_window=SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(
400	        pattern=[2048, -1],                       # 1:1 交替：滑窗 / 全注意力
401	        force_full_attention_on_first_layer=True,
402	        force_full_attention_on_last_layer=True,
403	    ),
404	)
405	
406	# 3) 序列化往返：定制结果应能无损存取（呼应 u2-l1 的 round-trip）

    A config for easily building transformer models.

    :param name: The name of the implementation.

    See :class:`Transformer` for a description of the other parameters.
    """

    d_model: int
    vocab_size: int
    n_layers: int
    block: TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig]
    lm_head: LMHeadConfig
    embedding_norm: Optional[LayerNormConfig] = None
    name: TransformerType = TransformerType.default
    dtype: DType = DType.float32
    init_method: InitMethod = InitMethod.normal
    init_seed: int = 0
    init_std: float = 0.02
    embedding_init_std: Optional[float] = None
    freeze_params: Optional[List[str]] = None
    block_pattern: Optional[List[str]] = None
    block_overrides: Optional[Dict[int, TransformerBlockConfig]] = None
    embed_scale: Optional[float] = None
    tie_word_embeddings: bool = False
    n_extra_vocab: int = 0
    """
    Number of extra token rows to append to the embedding table as a *separate* parameter
    (see :class:`~olmo_core.nn.embedding.SplitVocabEmbedding`). When non-zero,
    :data:`vocab_size` is the **base** vocab: lookups accept ``vocab_size + n_extra_vocab``
    IDs while the LM head spans only ``vocab_size``, so the extra tokens are inputs and never
    prediction targets. Used by Molmo2 for its 128 image-special tokens, and it lets the
    pretrained base rows be frozen on their own (``embeddings.weight``).
    """
    completedp: Optional[CompletedPConfig] = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.tie_word_embeddings and self.name == TransformerType.normalized:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                "Tying word embeddings is not supported with the normalized transformer"
            )
        if self.n_extra_vocab < 0:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError("'n_extra_vocab' cannot be negative")
        if self.n_extra_vocab and self.name != TransformerType.default:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"'n_extra_vocab' is only supported by the '{TransformerType.default}' "
                f"transformer, got '{self.name}'"
            )
        validate_block_resolution_config(
            n_layers=self.n_layers,
            block=self.block,
            block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
            block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
        )
        if self.block_pattern is not None and self.n_layers % len(self.block_pattern) != 0:
            log.warning(
                "`n_layers` (%d) is not divisible by the length of `block_pattern` (%d). "
                "The pattern will be cycled and truncated to fit `n_layers`, so the last "
                "cycle will be incomplete.",
                self.n_layers,
                len(self.block_pattern),
            )

    def build(
        self,
        *,
        init_device: str = "cpu",
    ) -> "Transformer":
        """
        Build the model corresponding to this config.

        :param init_device: The device to put the parameters on during initialization. In a
            distributed setting it usually makes sense to set this to "meta".
        """
        from .model import MoETransformer, NormalizedTransformer, Transformer

        log.info(
            f"Building transformer with {self.num_params:,d} total params, "
            f"{self.num_non_embedding_params:,d} non-embedding params"
        )
        model: Transformer
        if self.completedp is not None and self.name not in (
            TransformerType.default,
            TransformerType.moe_fused_v2,
        ):
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"CompletedP is not supported for transformer type '{self.name}'"
            )
        if self.name == TransformerType.default:
            model = Transformer(
                d_model=self.d_model,
                vocab_size=self.vocab_size,
                n_layers=self.n_layers,
                block=self.block,
                embedding_norm=self.embedding_norm,
                lm_head=self.lm_head,
                dtype=self.dtype.as_pt(),
                init_method=self.init_method,
                init_device=init_device,
                init_seed=self.init_seed,
                init_std=self.init_std,
                embedding_init_std=self.embedding_init_std,
                block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
                block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
                embed_scale=self.embed_scale,
                tie_word_embeddings=self.tie_word_embeddings,
                n_extra_vocab=self.n_extra_vocab,
                completedp=self.completedp,
            )
        elif self.name == TransformerType.normalized:
            assert self.embedding_norm is None
            model = NormalizedTransformer(
                d_model=self.d_model,
                vocab_size=self.vocab_size,
                n_layers=self.n_layers,
                block=self.block,
                lm_head=self.lm_head,
                dtype=self.dtype.as_pt(),
                init_method=self.init_method,
                init_device=init_device,
                init_seed=self.init_seed,
                init_std=self.init_std,
                embedding_init_std=self.embedding_init_std,
                block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
                block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
            )
        elif self.name == TransformerType.moe:
            model = MoETransformer(
                d_model=self.d_model,
                vocab_size=self.vocab_size,
                n_layers=self.n_layers,
                block=self.block,
                embedding_norm=self.embedding_norm,
                lm_head=self.lm_head,
                dtype=self.dtype.as_pt(),
                init_method=self.init_method,
                init_device=init_device,
                init_seed=self.init_seed,
                init_std=self.init_std,
                embedding_init_std=self.embedding_init_std,
                block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
                block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
                tie_word_embeddings=self.tie_word_embeddings,
            )
        elif self.name == TransformerType.moe_fused_v2:
            raise RuntimeError("Use OLMoDDPModelConfig")
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(self.name)

        if self.freeze_params:
            for name, param in model.named_parameters():
                for pattern in self.freeze_params:
                    if fnmatch(name, pattern):
                        param.requires_grad = False
                        log.info(f"Param '{name}' will be frozen")
                        break
                else:
                    log.info(f"Param '{name}' will be trainable")

        log.info("%s", model)
        log.info(
            f"Built model with:\n"
            f"- {model.num_params:,d} total params\n"
            f"- {model.num_non_embedding_params:,d} non-embedding params\n"
            f"- {model.num_trainable_params:,d} trainable params"
        )

        return model

    @property
    def resolved_block_configs(self) -> list[TransformerBlockConfig]:
        return resolve_block_configs(
            n_layers=self.n_layers,
            block=self.block,
            block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
            block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
        )

    @property
    def num_params(self) -> int:
        """
        The total number of parameters that a model from this config would have.
        """
        num_params = 0

        # Embedding params.
        num_params += self.d_model * self.vocab_size
        if self.embedding_norm is not None:
            num_params += self.embedding_norm.num_params(self.d_model)

        # All block params.
        for block_config in self.resolved_block_configs:
            num_params += block_config.num_params(self.d_model)

        # LM head.
        num_params += self.lm_head.num_params(self.d_model, self.vocab_size)

        # The LM head weight is shared with the embeddings when tied.
        if self.tie_word_embeddings:

        return num_params

    @property
    def num_active_params(self) -> int:
        """
        The total number of active parameters that a model from this config would have.
        """
        num_active_params = 0

        # Embedding params.
        num_active_params += self.d_model * self.vocab_size
        if self.embedding_norm is not None:
            num_active_params += self.embedding_norm.num_params(self.d_model)

        # All block active params.
        for block_config in self.resolved_block_configs:
            num_active_params += block_config.num_active_params(self.d_model)

        # LM head.
        num_active_params += self.lm_head.num_params(self.d_model, self.vocab_size)

        # The LM head weight is shared with the embeddings when tied.
        if self.tie_word_embeddings:
            num_active_params -= self.d_model * self.vocab_size

        return num_active_params

    @property
    def num_non_embedding_params(self) -> int:
        """
        The number of parameters excluding embedding parameters.
        """
        return self.num_params - self.d_model * self.vocab_size

    @property
    def num_active_non_embedding_params(self) -> int:
        """
        The number of active parameters excluding embedding parameters.
        """
        return self.num_active_params - self.d_model * self.vocab_size

import logging

from olmo_core.config import UNSET, DType, StrEnum
from olmo_core.doc_utils import beta_feature
from olmo_core.exceptions import OLMoConfigurationError
from olmo_core.nn.attention.base import SequenceMixerConfig
from olmo_core.utils import ensure_multiple_of

from ..attention import (
    AttentionBackendName,
    AttentionConfig,
    AttentionType,
    GateConfig,
    GateGranularity,
    SlidingWindowAttentionConfig,
    _resolve_attention_backend,
)
from ..attention.recurrent import GatedDeltaNetConfig
from ..buffer_cache import BufferCache
from ..config import ModelConfig, ModuleConfig
from ..feed_forward import ActivationFunction, FeedForwardConfig, FeedForwardType
from ..layer_norm import LayerNormConfig, LayerNormType
from ..lm_head import LMHeadConfig, LMHeadType
from ..moe import MoEConfig, MoERouterConfig, MoEType
from ..rope import RoPEConfig, RoPEScalingConfig, RoPEType
from .completedp import CompletedPConfig
from .init import InitMethod

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from .block import TransformerBlockBase
    from .model import Transformer

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class TransformerDataParallelWrappingStrategy(StrEnum):
    """
    An enumeration of the different wrapping strategy for the data parallel implementations.
    """

    full = "full"
    """
    Wrap each block and the LM head (only applies to FSDP).
    """

    blocks = "blocks"
    """
    Like full but the LM head is not wrapped separately (only applies to FSDP).
    """

    fine_grained = "fine_grained"
    """
    Wrap certain modules within each block in addition to wrapping each block (only applies to FSDP).
    """


@beta_feature
class TransformerActivationCheckpointingMode(StrEnum):
    """
    An enumeration of the different activation checkpointing modes.
    """

    full = "full"
    """Checkpoint every block."""
    selected_blocks = "selected_blocks"
    """Checkpoint only selected blocks."""
    selected_modules = "selected_modules"
    """Checkpoint only selected modules."""
    selected_ops = "selected_ops"
    """Checkpoint only a specific set of operations."""
    budget = "budget"
    """Checkpoint based on a budget."""


class TransformerType(StrEnum):
    """
    An enumeration of transformer implementations.
    """

    default = "default"
    """
    ➡️ :class:`Transformer`
    """

    normalized = "normalized"
    """
    ➡️ :class:`NormalizedTransformer` (nGPT)
    """

    moe = "moe"
    """

def llama_like(
        cls,
        *,
        d_model: int,
        vocab_size: int,
        n_layers: int,
        n_heads: int,
        n_kv_heads: Optional[int] = None,
        head_dim: Optional[int] = None,
        gate: Optional[GateConfig] = None,
        qk_norm: bool = False,
        use_head_qk_norm: bool = False,
        layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5,
        layer_norm_name: Optional[LayerNormType] = None,
        rope_theta: int = 500_000,
        rope_type: Optional[RoPEType] = None,
        rope_full_precision: bool = True,
        no_global_rope: bool = False,
        hidden_size_multiple_of: int = 256,
        hidden_size_multiplier: Optional[float] = None,
        fused_ops: bool = False,
        use_flash: Optional[bool] = None,  # Deprecated; use attn_backend instead.
        attn_backend: Optional[AttentionBackendName] = None,
        sliding_window: Optional[SlidingWindowAttentionConfig] = None,
        block_name: TransformerBlockType = TransformerBlockType.default,
        block_mods: Optional[
            Dict[int, Callable[[TransformerBlockConfig], TransformerBlockConfig]]
        ] = None,
        dtype: DType = DType.float32,
        rope_scaling: Optional[RoPEScalingConfig] = None,
        feed_forward: Optional[FeedForwardConfig] = None,
        feed_forward_moe: Optional[MoEConfig] = None,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> "TransformerConfig":
        """
        Create a Llama-like model configuration.

        :param hidden_size_multiple_of: Ensure the FFN hidden size is a multiple of this value.
        :param hidden_size_multiplier: Custom multiplier for the FFN hidden size.
        :param fused_ops: Use fused operations where possible.
        :param layer_norm_name: Override the layer norm implementation. Defaults to
            :data:`LayerNormType.fused_rms` when ``fused_ops=True``, otherwise
            :data:`LayerNormType.rms`.
        :param block_mods: A dictionary of block indices to functions that take the base block config and return a modified block config.
        :param dtype: The default data type to use for all parameters.
        """
        # Resolve hidden size of FFN in blocks.
        hidden_size = int(8 * d_model / 3)
        if hidden_size_multiplier is not None:
            hidden_size = int(hidden_size_multiplier * hidden_size)
        hidden_size = ensure_multiple_of(hidden_size, hidden_size_multiple_of)

        # Configure global layer norm.
        if layer_norm_name is None:
            layer_norm_name = LayerNormType.fused_rms if fused_ops else LayerNormType.rms
        layer_norm = LayerNormConfig(
            name=layer_norm_name,
            eps=layer_norm_eps,
            bias=False,
            dtype=dtype,
        )

        # Decide on attention/rope implementations.
        att_type = AttentionType.default
        if rope_type is None:
            rope_type = RoPEType.default
            if fused_ops and n_kv_heads is None:
                att_type = AttentionType.fused_v2
                use_flash = None  # The original fused implementation ignored this flag.
                if attn_backend is None:
                    attn_backend = AttentionBackendName.flash_2

        # Feed-forward.
        if feed_forward is None and feed_forward_moe is None:
            feed_forward = FeedForwardConfig(hidden_size=hidden_size, bias=False, dtype=dtype)

        # Configure blocks.
        block = TransformerBlockConfig(
            name=block_name,
            sequence_mixer=AttentionConfig(
                name=att_type,
                n_heads=n_heads,
                n_kv_heads=n_kv_heads,
                head_dim=head_dim,
                bias=False,
                rope=RoPEConfig(
                    name=rope_type,
                    theta=rope_theta,
                    full_precision=rope_full_precision,
                    no_global_rope=no_global_rope,
                    scaling=rope_scaling,
                ),
                gate=gate,
                qk_norm=layer_norm if qk_norm else None,
                use_head_qk_norm=use_head_qk_norm if qk_norm else None,
                backend=_resolve_attention_backend(attn_backend, use_flash),
                sliding_window=sliding_window,
                dtype=dtype,
            ),
            feed_forward=feed_forward,
            feed_forward_moe=feed_forward_moe,
            layer_norm=layer_norm,
        )

        if block_mods and kwargs.get("block_overrides"):
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                "`block_mods` and `block_overrides` cannot be used together."
            )
        block_overrides = None
        if block_mods:
            block_overrides = {i: block_mods[i](block.copy()) for i in block_mods}
        elif kwargs.get("block_overrides"):
            block_overrides = kwargs.get("block_overrides")

        return cls(
            d_model=d_model,
            vocab_size=vocab_size,
            n_layers=n_layers,
            block=block,
            lm_head=LMHeadConfig(layer_norm=layer_norm, bias=False, dtype=dtype),
            dtype=dtype,
            block_overrides=block_overrides,
            **kwargs,
        )

"""
    Restrict block-level recomputation to the named submodules of each block.
    """

    def build(
        self,
        *,
        init_device: str = "cpu",
    ) -> "Transformer":
        """
        Build the model corresponding to this config.

        :param init_device: The device to put the parameters on during initialization. In a
            distributed setting it usually makes sense to set this to "meta".
        """
        from .model import Transformer

        log.info(
            f"Building transformer with {self.num_params:,d} total params, "
            f"{self.num_non_embedding_params:,d} non-embedding params"
        )
        model: Transformer
        if self.name == TransformerType.moe_fused_v2:
            from olmo_core.nn.ddp.model import OLMoDDPModel

            model = OLMoDDPModel(
                d_model=self.d_model,
                vocab_size=self.vocab_size,
                n_layers=self.n_layers,
                block=self.block,
                lm_head=self.lm_head,
                dtype=self.dtype.as_pt(),
                init_method=self.init_method,
                init_device=init_device,
                init_seed=self.init_seed,
                init_std=self.init_std,
                block_overrides=self.block_overrides,
                two_batch_overlap=self.two_batch_overlap,
                recompute_all_blocks_by_chunk=self.recompute_all_blocks_by_chunk,
                recompute_each_block=self.recompute_each_block,
                recompute_block_keys=self.recompute_block_keys,
                embedding_norm=self.embedding_norm,
                embedding_init_std=self.embedding_init_std,
                embed_scale=self.embed_scale,
                block_pattern=self.block_pattern,
                tie_word_embeddings=self.tie_word_embeddings,
                completedp=self.completedp,
            )
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(self.name)

        if self.freeze_params:
            for name, param in model.named_parameters():
                for pattern in self.freeze_params:
                    if fnmatch(name, pattern):
                        param.requires_grad = False
                        log.info(f"Param '{name}' will be frozen")
                        break
                else:
                    log.info(f"Param '{name}' will be trainable")

        log.info("%s", model)
        return model


def validate_block_resolution_config(
    n_layers: int,
    block: TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig],
    block_pattern: list[str] | None = None,
    block_overrides: dict[int, TransformerBlockConfig] | None = None,
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(block, dict):
        if block_pattern is not None:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                "`block_pattern` is not supported when `block` is not a dict of named blocks."
            )
        return

    if not block_pattern:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            "`block_pattern` must be provided and non-empty when `block` is a dict of named blocks."
        )
    if block_overrides is not None:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            "`block_overrides` is not supported when `block` is a dict of named blocks; "
            "use `block_pattern` to control per-layer block selection."
        )

    available_block_names = set(block.keys())
    missing_block_names = set(block_pattern) - available_block_names
    if missing_block_names:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            "Every name in `block_pattern` must exist in `block`. "
            f"Unknown names: {missing_block_names}. Available names: {available_block_names}."
        )


def resolve_block_configs(
    n_layers: int,
    block: TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig],
    block_pattern: list[str] | None = None,
    block_overrides: dict[int, TransformerBlockConfig] | None = None,
) -> list[TransformerBlockConfig]:
    """Resolve the block configuration for each layer."""
    validate_block_resolution_config(
        n_layers=n_layers,
        block=block,
        block_pattern=block_pattern,
        block_overrides=block_overrides,
    )

    block_configs: list[TransformerBlockConfig]
    if isinstance(block, dict):
        # Named-block configuration.
        assert block_pattern is not None

"""Whether to always apply gating in full precision regardless of the input data type."""


@dataclass
class SlidingWindowAttentionConfig(Config):
    pattern: List[int]
    """
    The pattern of window sizes to use for attention, repeated to cover all layers.
    A value of -1 indicates full attention. For example, a pattern of ``[4096, 4096, 4096, -1]``
    means that for each set of 4 layers, the first 3 will use a window size of 4096,
    and the last layer will use full attention.
    """

    force_full_attention_on_first_layer: bool = True
    """
    If `True`, the first transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
    """

    force_full_attention_on_last_layer: bool = True
    """
    If `True`, the last transformer layer will always use full attention, regardless of the pattern.
    """

    def _get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the window size for a given layer, returning -1 for full attention.
        """
        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer and layer_idx == 0:
            return -1
        if self.force_full_attention_on_last_layer and layer_idx == (n_layers - 1):
            return -1

        # Adjust the layer index if the first layer is special-cased to full attention
        # (in which case the pattern is applied starting from the second layer)
        effective_layer_idx = layer_idx
        if self.force_full_attention_on_first_layer:
            effective_layer_idx -= 1

        window_size = self.pattern[effective_layer_idx % len(self.pattern)]
        if window_size <= 0 and window_size != -1:
            raise OLMoConfigurationError(
                f"Sliding window size must be positive or -1 (got {window_size})"
            )
        return window_size

    def should_use_swa(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> bool:
        """
        Returns `True` if the given layer uses sliding window attention.
        """
        return self._get_window_size(layer_idx, n_layers) != -1

    def get_window_size(self, layer_idx: int, n_layers: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the sliding window size for a given layer.
        """

import json
from typing import Any, Callable

from cached_path import cached_path

from olmo_core.nn.transformer.config import TransformerBlockConfig, TransformerConfig

# OLMO3_7B_CHECKPOINT = "https://olmo-checkpoints.org/ai2-llm/Olmo-3-1025-7B/stage1/step0"
OLMO3_7B_CHECKPOINT = (
    "https://huggingface.co/buckets/allenai/ai2-llm/resolve/checkpoints/OLMo25/step0"
)


def test_load_olmo3_7b_config():
    """Verify that old checkpoint configs with a single block (not a dict) still load correctly."""
    config_path = cached_path(f"{OLMO3_7B_CHECKPOINT}/config.json")
    with open(config_path) as f:
        config_dict = json.load(f)

    config = TransformerConfig.from_dict(config_dict["model"])

    assert config.d_model == 4096
    assert config.n_layers == 32
    assert config.vocab_size == 100352
    assert isinstance(config.block, TransformerBlockConfig)
    assert config.block.name == "reordered_norm"

    # Round-trip through as_config_dict / from_dict should be lossless.
    roundtripped = TransformerConfig.from_dict(config.as_config_dict())
    assert roundtripped.as_config_dict() == config.as_config_dict()

37	class CompletedPConfig(Config):
38	    """
39	    Width and depth settings for the CompletedP parameterization from
40	    `Mlodozeniec et al., 2025 <https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22382>`_ (Table 1), which extends
41	    CompleteP (`Dey et al., 2025 <https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.01618>`_).
42	
43	    Set it as :data:`~olmo_core.nn.transformer.TransformerConfig.completedp` on the model config,
44	    and set :class:`~olmo_core.optim.CompletedPOptimConfig` on an AdamW optimizer config, which
45	    reads these settings from the model. On the model this:
46	
47	    - scales every residual branch by ``(n_layers / base_depth) ** -alpha``;
48	    - multiplies the :data:`~olmo_core.nn.transformer.init.InitMethod.normal` init of each hidden
49	      weight matrix by ``sqrt(1 / r)``, and of the LM head and of each in-block matrix with a fixed
50	      output size (routers, KDA ``f_proj_1`` / ``g_proj_1``, and attention ``w_k`` / ``w_v`` with
51	      :data:`fixed_kv_width`) by ``1 / r``, so the init variance
52	      scales as ``1 / width`` and ``1 / width**2``.
53	
54	    ``r = fan_in / base_fan_in`` is a matrix's own width ratio: its fan-in over the fan-in of the
55	    same matrix in the base model. Dimensions that grow at different rates (or not at all, like a
56	    fixed low-rank projection) each get the right ratio, and every matrix of the base model has
57	    ``r == 1``. Build the config with :meth:`from_base_model`, which records the base fan-ins.
58	
59	    The base hyperparameters (``init_std``, and the optimizer's ``lr``, ``eps``, ``weight_decay``
60	    and ``betas``) are the values for the base model, which gets exactly them. Keep the config
61	    fixed across the models being compared.
62	    """
63	
64	    base_width: int
65	    """
66	    The ``d_model`` of the base model, the model the base hyperparameters were tuned on.
67	    """
68	
69	    base_depth: int
70	    """
71	    The number of blocks of the base model.
72	    """
73	
74	    alpha: float = 1.0
75	    """
76	    The depth exponent, in ``[0.5, 1]``. ``1.0`` is CompleteP.
77	    """

@dataclass
class CompletedPConfig(Config):
    """
    Width and depth settings for the CompletedP parameterization from
    `Mlodozeniec et al., 2025 <https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22382>`_ (Table 1), which extends
    CompleteP (`Dey et al., 2025 <https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.01618>`_).

    Set it as :data:`~olmo_core.nn.transformer.TransformerConfig.completedp` on the model config,
    and set :class:`~olmo_core.optim.CompletedPOptimConfig` on an AdamW optimizer config, which
    reads these settings from the model. On the model this:

    - scales every residual branch by ``(n_layers / base_depth) ** -alpha``;
    - multiplies the :data:`~olmo_core.nn.transformer.init.InitMethod.normal` init of each hidden
      weight matrix by ``sqrt(1 / r)``, and of the LM head and of each in-block matrix with a fixed
      output size (routers, KDA ``f_proj_1`` / ``g_proj_1``, and attention ``w_k`` / ``w_v`` with
      :data:`fixed_kv_width`) by ``1 / r``, so the init variance
      scales as ``1 / width`` and ``1 / width**2``.

    ``r = fan_in / base_fan_in`` is a matrix's own width ratio: its fan-in over the fan-in of the
    same matrix in the base model. Dimensions that grow at different rates (or not at all, like a
    fixed low-rank projection) each get the right ratio, and every matrix of the base model has
    ``r == 1``. Build the config with :meth:`from_base_model`, which records the base fan-ins.

    The base hyperparameters (``init_std``, and the optimizer's ``lr``, ``eps``, ``weight_decay``
    and ``betas``) are the values for the base model, which gets exactly them. Keep the config
    fixed across the models being compared.
    """

    base_width: int
    """
    The ``d_model`` of the base model, the model the base hyperparameters were tuned on.
    """

    base_depth: int
    """
    The number of blocks of the base model.
    """

    alpha: float = 1.0
    """
    The depth exponent, in ``[0.5, 1]``. ``1.0`` is CompleteP.
    """

    base_block_fan_ins: Optional[List[Dict[str, int]]] = None
    """
    The fan-in of every weight matrix in the base model's blocks: one mapping per distinct block
    structure, from a matrix's name inside its block (e.g. ``"attention.w_out.weight"``) to its
    fan-in. A block of another model uses the mapping with exactly its set of matrix names.
    Set by :meth:`from_base_model`.

    If unset, every matrix uses ``base_width`` as its base fan-in. Matrices whose fan-in isn't
    ``d_model`` (e.g. an MLP's down projection) then don't get the base hyperparameters even in the
    base model. This is kept only so that runs started with it keep their parameterization.
    """

    fixed_kv_width: bool = False
    """
    Whether the key/value width of softmax attention (``n_kv_heads * head_dim``) is the same in
    every model being compared. If so, attention's ``w_k`` and ``w_v`` have a fixed output size
    and are readout matrices (:data:`CompletedPRole.hidden_readout_matrix`) rather than hidden
    ones. Only set it when the key/value width really is fixed. It doesn't affect linear attention
    (KDA, GatedDeltaNet), and it isn't supported with fused QKV projections.
    """

# TransformerConfig 与预置架构工厂方法

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u3-l1）我们读了 `Transformer` 与 `TransformerBlock` 的前向主链路，知道了数据如何从 `input_ids` 一路流到 logits。本讲把视角拉回到「模型是怎么被描述出来的」：

1. 读懂 `TransformerConfig` 中每个字段对应的模型结构含义——看完你就知道一张「模型图纸」上到底画了哪些信息（包括本轮新加入的可选 `completedp` 参数化字段，本讲只认识它，完整机制留给 u10-l8）。
2. 会用 `olmo2_190M()`、`olmo3_7B()` 这类预置工厂方法快速构建模型配置，并说清楚 olmo2 与 olmo3 预设的差别。
3. 掌握贯穿全库的复用模式：**Config 工厂方法 + kwargs 覆盖**——一行调用既能选定规模档位，又能随手改掉任何深层参数。
4. 理解 `build()` 如何从图纸初始化出一个真实模型，以及 `num_params` 如何在建模之前就精确算出参数量。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲假设你已读过：

- **u2-l1 / u2-l2**：`Config` 是可序列化的嵌套 dataclass，`ModuleConfig` 提供抽象的 `build()`，`ModelConfig` 再加上 `num_params` 等属性。`TransformerConfig` 正是这条继承链的成员。
- **u3-l1**：`Transformer` 顶层只做编排，`n_layers` 个 `TransformerBlock` 堆叠在残差流上；OLMo 2 默认 block 是 `reordered_norm`（norm 在子层输出侧）。

几个本讲反复出现的术语，先用一句话解释：

| 术语 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `d_model` | 残差流宽度（隐藏维度）。中间所有层都保持这个宽度，形状只在 embedding 入口和 lm_head 出口变化。 |
| `n_heads` / `n_kv_heads` | 查询头数 / 键值头数。`n_kv_heads < n_heads` 时就是 **GQA**（分组查询注意力，多组 Q 共享一组 KV，省 KV cache 与投影参数）；`n_kv_heads` 留空（`None`）表示等于 `n_heads`，即标准 MHA。 |
| `head_dim` | 每个注意力头的维度。留空时在构建期推导为 `d_model // n_heads`（见 [src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py:L700-L704](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py#L700-L704)）。部分模型（如 Qwen3）会显式指定与 `d_model // n_heads` 不同的 `head_dim`。 |
| FFN hidden size | 前馈网络（SwiGLU）中间层宽度。`llama_like` 里由 `d_model` 乘系数推导（见 4.3.3）。 |
| `reordered_norm` | OLMo 2 的 block 布局：两个 LayerNorm 放在注意力/FFN 的输出侧（post-norm 风格）。 |
| RoPE `theta` | 旋转位置编码的基频，越大越适合长上下文（OLMo 2/3 用 500 000，Qwen3 用 1 000 000）。 |
| `completedp` | 可选的 **CompletedP 参数化**配置：声明一个「基准宽度/深度」，让初始化与优化器超参能按模型加宽/加深的比例自动缩放。默认 `None`（不启用，行为与旧版完全一致），完整机制在 u10-l8 展开。 |
| 参数量预算 | `num_params`：不实例化模型，仅凭 Config 算出的精确参数总数。 |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py) | **本讲主角**。`TransformerConfig`、`TransformerBlockConfig`、全部预置工厂方法、block 解析逻辑都在这一个文件里（约 2240 行）。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/config.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py) | `ModuleConfig` / `ModelConfig` 抽象基类，定义 `build()` 与 `num_params` 契约。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/init.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/init.py) | `InitMethod` 枚举：权重初始化方案（详细机制在 u3-l6 展开）。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/completedp.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/completedp.py) | `CompletedPConfig`：挂在 `TransformerConfig.completedp` 字段上的参数化配置（基准宽度/深度等），本轮新增，本讲只做认知性介绍。 |
| [src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/attention/__init__.py) | `AttentionConfig`、`SlidingWindowAttentionConfig` 等被 `TransformerConfig` 组合的子配置。 |
| [src/olmo_core/utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/utils.py) | `ensure_multiple_of`：FFN 宽度对齐工具。 |
| [src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/test/nn/transformer/model_test.py) | 断言 `config.num_params` 与实际构建参数量严格相等；展示 kwargs 覆盖用法。 |
| [src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/test/nn/transformer/config_test.py) | 配置加载、round-trip 与工厂方法的回归测试。 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 TransformerConfig：一张描述模型全部形状的图纸

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

u3-l1 里我们直接读了 `Transformer` 类的 `__init__` 参数——那有十几个位置参数，手工拼装既繁琐又容易错。`TransformerConfig` 解决的就是这个问题：把「造一个 Transformer 需要知道的一切」收进一个可序列化、可校验、可复用的 dataclass。

它的设计要点：

1. **复合配置**：`TransformerConfig` 不重复定义注意力、FFN、LayerNorm 的细节，而是嵌套持有 `TransformerBlockConfig`、`LMHeadConfig` 等子配置——这正是 u2-l1 讲过的「Config 嵌套组合」模式。
2. **顶层管形状，block 管内部**：`d_model`、`n_layers` 这类全局量在顶层；每个 block 内部用什么注意力、什么 FFN 由 `TransformerBlockConfig` 描述。
3. **构造即校验**：`__post_init__` 在对象诞生时就拒绝非法组合（比如 `tie_word_embeddings` 搭配 normalized transformer）。
4. **可选功能走「空默认」字段**：新能力（如本轮的 `completedp` 参数化）以 `Optional[...] = None` 字段加入，不开就不生效——这样新旧配置天然兼容。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`TransformerConfig` 的字段可以分成四组来记：

```text
┌─ 形状骨架 ─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  d_model / vocab_size / n_layers                        │
├─ block 的组织方式 ──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  block（单个 或 dict[str, 多个命名 block]）              │
│  block_pattern（命名 block 的循环模式）                   │
│  block_overrides（按层号覆盖单 block）                    │
├─ 初始化与参数化 ────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  init_method / init_seed / init_std / embedding_init_std │
│  completedp（可选 CompletedP 参数化，详见 u10-l8）        │
│  dtype / freeze_params                                  │
├─ 词表与输出 ────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lm_head / embedding_norm / embed_scale                 │
│  tie_word_embeddings / n_extra_vocab                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

构造流程：`TransformerConfig(...)` → dataclass 赋值 → `__post_init__` 校验 → 得到一个可 `build()`、可 `as_config_dict()` 序列化的纯数据对象。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① 继承链与字段定义。** `TransformerConfig` 继承 `ModelConfig`（[src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L336-L372](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L336-L372)）：前五个字段 `d_model`、`vocab_size`、`n_layers`、`block`、`lm_head` 没有默认值，是必填项；其余都有默认值。注意 `block` 字段的类型是联合类型 `TransformerBlockConfig | dict[str, TransformerBlockConfig]`——这正是 4.2 节「block 三种组织方式」的入口。`name: TransformerType = TransformerType.default` 决定顶层用哪个实现类（default → `Transformer`，normalized → nGPT，moe → `MoETransformer`，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L81-L104](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L81-L104)）。

**② 新增的 `completedp` 字段。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L372](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L372) 定义了 `completedp: Optional[CompletedPConfig] = None`（类型从 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L32](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L32) 导入）。它是本轮提交（704625ad9）加入的**可选参数化开关**：设置后，模型侧会按「基准模型的宽度/深度」缩放初始化方差与残差分支（配置类 `CompletedPConfig` 的字段与 docstring 见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/completedp.py:L36-L98](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/completedp.py#L36-L98)），优化器侧则由 `AdamWConfig.completedp` 读取同一份配置缩放各组超参。**默认 `None` 时它完全不参与任何计算**——这是「用组合字段而非子类扩展 Config」的又一个例子（对照 u2-l2 末尾的讨论）。本讲只需记住它的存在与入口，公式与缩放规则留给 u10-l8。

**③ `__post_init__` 校验。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L374-L399](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L374-L399) 依次检查：normalized transformer 不许 tie 词嵌入；`n_extra_vocab` 非负且只支持 default 类型；然后调用 `validate_block_resolution_config` 确保 `block` / `block_pattern` / `block_overrides` 三者组合合法（细节见 4.2.3）。若 `n_layers` 不能被 `block_pattern` 长度整除，只发 warning 不报错——模式会循环后截断。

**④ `TransformerBlockConfig` 的字段。** [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L163-L213](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L163-L213)：

- `sequence_mixer`：序列混合器配置（通常是 `AttentionConfig`，也可以是 `GatedDeltaNetConfig` 等线性注意力——Qwen3.5 预设就是这么用的）。它是唯一必填字段。
- `attention`：已废弃的 `InitVar`，仅为兼容旧配置保留；`__post_init__` 里会把它搬到 `sequence_mixer`（[L215-L227](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L215-L227)）。
- `layer_norm` / `feed_forward` / `feed_forward_moe`：dense block 需要 `feed_forward`，MoE block 需要 `feed_forward_moe`，hybrid MoE 则两者都有。
- `name: TransformerBlockType`：选 block 布局（default / reordered_norm / peri_norm / moe 系列等，见 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L107-L160](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L107-L160)）。
- `dropout` / `masked_dropout` / `attention_residual_alpha` / `feed_forward_residual_alpha`：正则与残差缩放的可选项。

**⑤ 基类契约。** `ModuleConfig` 只要求一个抽象 `build()`（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L9-L16](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L9-L16)）；`ModelConfig` 再要求 `num_params`、`num_non_embedding_params` 两个抽象属性（[src/olmo_core/nn/config.py:L19-L43](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/config.py#L19-L43)）。`TransformerConfig` 把这些全部实现了。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不看工厂方法，手写一个最小的合法 `TransformerConfig`，并亲身体验一次校验报错。

**操作步骤**（以下为示例代码，可在仓库根目录用 `python -I` 逐段运行）：

d_model = 64

**需要观察的现象**：第二段代码抛出的错误信息会告诉你 `block_pattern` 只在 `block` 为 dict 时可用（对应 [src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py:L2161-L2166](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/transformer/config.py#L2161-L2166) 的校验分支）。
